example: Few people fully understand how their personal data is collected and sold. (很少人完全理解自己的個人資料如何被蒐集和販售。)
The average household spends a large part of its monthly income on housing and transport. (一般家庭每月收入有很大一部分花在住屋和交通上。)
The level of reading among new local pupils varies considerably, so teachers carefully group them into three ability levels. (當地新生的閱讀程度差異很大，因此教師依能力仔細把他們分成三組。)
The present transport system cannot cope with the growing number of daily visitors. (目前的運輸系統無法應付日益增加的每日訪客。)
Children learn languages more easily than adults, especially before the age of ten. (兒童學語言比成人容易，尤其是在十歲以前。)
Each member of the small research team contributed useful ideas to the final plan. (小型研究團隊的每位成員都為最終計畫貢獻了有用的想法。)
The visa process took six weeks, mostly because one simple document had been uploaded incorrectly. (簽證流程花了六週，主要是因為一份簡單文件上傳錯誤。)
Volunteering abroad gave her valuable experience of working with people from very different cultures. (海外志工的經歷讓她獲得與來自截然不同文化的人共事的寶貴經驗。)
The temperature drops sharply at night in the desert, even during summer. (沙漠裡即使在夏天，夜間氣溫也會驟降。)
The new local scheme supports families who are caring full-time for frail elderly relatives at home. (這項新的地方方案支援在家全職照顧體弱年長親屬的家庭。)
Volunteers sort the donated clothes into piles for children, adults and elderly people. (志工把捐贈衣物分類成兒童、成人和長者幾堆。)
The term 'carbon footprint' is now widely used in everyday conversation about climate. (「碳足跡」這個術語如今廣泛用於日常氣候對話中。)
Share prices fell sharply after the company reported weaker than expected annual profits. (公司公布的年利潤低於預期後，股價大幅下跌。)
The new product was tested by hundreds of consumers before it reached the shops. (這項新產品在上架前經過數百名消費者測試。)
Nearly one million people visit the old city during the summer months. (夏季期間有將近百萬人參觀這座老城。)
The unemployment rate fell slightly last month, according to the latest official figures. (根據官方數據，上個月的失業率略為下降。)
The medicine controls the pain effectively, but unfortunately its main side effect is persistent tiredness during the day. (這種藥能有效控制疼痛，但可惜主要副作用是白天持續疲倦。)
In my view, the council should invest more in safe walking and cycling routes. (依我的見解，市議會應該多投資安全的步行和自行車路線。)
Her story of recovery after the accident inspired many readers of the magazine. (她在事故後康復的故事，激勵了許多雜誌讀者。)
The building has five storeys, and the top floor is a restaurant. (這棟建築有五個樓層，頂樓是一家餐廳。)
Many local businesses have benefited greatly from the increase in weekend visitors. (許多當地企業因週末訪客增加而受益良多。)
The colour of the walls makes the small room feel much brighter. (牆壁的顏色讓這個小房間感覺明亮許多。)
A good bit of luck helped us find the house, since the address was slightly wrong. (我們靠一點好運找到了那棟房子，因為地址有些錯誤。)

meaning: n. 令人擔憂的事；憂慮
example: A growing concern among local parents is the increasing amount of time children spend staring at small screens. (當地家長越來越擔憂的一件事，是孩子盯著小螢幕的時間不斷增加。)
Engineers test the bridge every year to check for cracks and corrosion. (工程師每年測試這座橋，檢查是否有裂縫和腐蝕。)
The house was withdrawn from sale after the survey found serious structural problems. (鑑定發現嚴重結構問題後，這棟房子停止出售。)
The doctor suggested walking daily, adding that even twenty brisk minutes would make a noticeable difference to her health. (醫師建議她每天走路，還說即使快走二十分鐘，對健康也會有明顯差別。)
The two firms signed a deal to share the research and development costs equally. (兩家公司簽署協議，平均分攤研發成本。)
Learning a second language as an adult takes patience, regular practice and plenty of confidence. (成年後學第二語言需要耐心、規律練習和充分的自信。)
Analysts expect house prices to fall slightly before the end of the year. (分析師預料房價會在年底前略微下跌。)
The museum rules allow visitors to take photographs but not to use flash. (博物館規定允許訪客拍照，但不得使用閃光燈。)
Poor drainage caused the flooding that closed the main road for two days. (排水不良引起淹水，導致主要道路封閉兩天。)
Solar power now supplies a quarter of the electricity used by the town. (太陽能現在供應這座城鎮四分之一的用電。)
He changed the subject whenever money was mentioned, which made planning the trip difficult. (每次提到錢，他就尷尬地轉移話題，這讓規劃整趟旅行變得很困難。)
Children develop basic language skills fastest when adults talk and read with them regularly, not merely at them. (當大人經常陪孩子說話、閱讀，而不只是對他們說話時，孩子的基礎語言能力發展得最快。)
Keep a record of your spending so that you can see where money goes. (記下你的支出，才能看出錢花到哪裡去。)
Keeping a diary can help clear the mind after a long and stressful day. (寫日記有助於在漫長疲累的一天後讓頭腦清晰。)
She has held public office for twelve years and remains widely respected by voters. (她擔任公職十二年，至今仍廣受選民敬重。)
A knee injury forced the dancer to retire early, ending a successful career that had lasted twenty years. (膝傷迫使這位舞者提早退休，結束長達二十年的成功職涯。)
It does not matter whether you start today or tomorrow, as long as you start. (你今天或明天開始都不要緊，只要真的開始就好。)
The restaurant donates its unsold food to a local shelter every evening. (這家餐廳每天晚上把沒賣完的食物捐給當地收容所。)
Most visa applications require applicants to show recent bank statements covering at least six months of steady income. (大多數簽證申請要求申請人提出近期的銀行對帳單，證明至少六個月有穩定收入。)

meaning: adj. 政治的；政治相關的
example: The debate became political when someone raised the difficult question of local taxation. (有人提出地方稅制這個棘手問題後，這場討論就變得政治化了。)
The council will decide next month whether to approve the new housing plan. (議會將在下個月決定是否核准新的住宅計畫。)
The hotel trains its staff to handle complaints before they reach the manager. (這家飯店訓練員工在申訴傳到經理之前就先處理好。)
The latest figures show unemployment falling steadily in the region, although youth joblessness remains stubbornly high across the whole country. (最新數字顯示該地區失業率穩定下降，儘管全區青年失業率仍居高不下。)
Passengers were told to remain calm, although smoke was clearly visible at the back of the plane. (乘客被告知要保持冷靜，儘管機艙後方明顯可見煙霧。)
The large company increased digital security after hackers obtained customers' personal addresses, but many users still feel unprotected. (這家大公司在駭客取得顧客個人地址後加強數位安全，但許多使用者仍覺得沒有保障。)
Wait a minute, the express train to the airport does not leave until ten. (等一下，到機場的特快車十點才開。)
The city funded free bus travel for pensioners on weekday mornings last year. (這座城市去年資助長者在平日上午免費搭公車。)
The recipe involves several slow steps, including resting the dough overnight before baking. (這份食譜包含幾個需要慢慢進行的步驟，包括烘焙前讓麵團靜置一夜。)
Her account of the long journey was vivid, describing the dust, the heat and the kindness of strangers. (她對這趟漫長旅程的敘述很生動，描述了塵土、酷熱和陌生人的善意。)
History shows that technological change often creates new jobs while destroying old ones. (歷史顯示，技術變革往往在消滅舊工作的同時創造新工作。)
The new motorway created constant noise, making it hard for nearby residents to sleep. (新高速公路帶來持續噪音，讓附近居民難以入睡。)
Please wait a moment while I find the correct file for your application. (請稍等一下，我幫你找申請所需的正確檔案。)
Each individual household is responsible for sorting its waste before collection day. (每個家庭都必須在收垃圾日前自行分類垃圾。)
Staff cleared the tables quickly so that the next group of guests could sit down. (工作人員迅速清空桌子，好讓下一組客人入座。)
The referee applied the rule strictly, even though the home crowd disagreed loudly. (儘管主場觀眾大聲抗議，裁判仍嚴格執行規則。)
A sound diet and regular exercise reduce the risk of heart disease. (均衡的飲食和規律運動能降低心臟病的風險。)
Recent research suggests that short naps can improve afternoon performance at work. (最近的研究顯示，短暫午睡能提升下午的工作表現。)
A tall stranger appears in the background of the old photograph, although nobody remembers seeing him that day. (這張老照片的背景裡出現一位高個子陌生人，但沒有人記得那天見過他。)
The general view among researchers is that regular moderate exercise still benefits almost everyone, including people over eighty. (研究人員的普遍看法是，規律的中度運動仍對幾乎所有人有益，包括八十歲以上的人。)
The new design failed to please customers, so the company changed it again. (新設計無法讓顧客滿意，所以公司又改了一次。)
Dogs have a very strong sense of smell and can detect tiny amounts of scent. (狗的嗅覺非常敏銳，能察覺極微量的氣味。)
The new figures add to concerns that rents are rising faster than wages. (新數據增加了人們的憂慮：租金漲得比薪資快。)
The law now requires all new buildings to meet strict energy efficiency standards. (法律現在要求所有新建築都必須達到嚴格的能源效率標準。)
The film was shot on location in the mountains over a period of six weeks. (這部影片在山區實地拍攝，前後花了六週。)
The architect built a detailed model of the housing project out of cardboard. (建築師用厚紙板做了一個住宅計畫的詳細模型。)
The new library design uses large windows and plenty of natural light. (新圖書館的設計採用大面窗戶和充足的自然光。)
The patient's serious condition improved gradually after major surgery, although he still needs supplementary oxygen every single night. (病人嚴重的病況在大手術後逐漸改善，不過他每晚仍需補充氧氣。)
The study compares the behaviour of humans with that of other social animals. (這項研究比較人類與其他社會性動物的行為。)
The vaccine is now widely available, although remote clinics still struggle to keep enough cold doses in stock. (這種疫苗如今已廣泛可得，儘管偏遠診所仍難以備妥足夠的冷藏劑量。)
Her overall position in the race improved steadily, although she never quite caught the two leaders ahead of her. (她在比賽中的總排名穩定進步，儘管始終沒能追上領先的兩名選手。)
The housing situation has improved slightly since the new flats were completed. (新公寓完工後，住宅狀況已略有改善。)
Her paper on urban farming was published in a highly respected journal. (她關於都市農耕的論文發表在一份知名期刊上。)
Thick snow covered the fields and closed the road for three days. (厚雪覆蓋田野，道路封閉了三天。)
The major cause of avoidable illness in the region is still untreated water, not lack of local hospitals. (這個地區可避免疾病的主要成因仍是未經處理的水，而非缺乏當地醫院。)
One angry customer complained again that the delivery had arrived three full days late. (一位氣憤的顧客再次抱怨，貨物整整遲了三天才送到。)
Consumers often choose products because of the label rather than the actual quality inside. (消費者常因為標籤而選擇產品，而不是因為裡面的實際品質。)
A brown bear was seen near the campsite, so visitors were warned. (有人在營地附近看到一頭棕熊，因此警告了訪客。)
It is simply hard to describe the relief we felt when the missing old dog finally came home. (走失的老狗終於回家時，我們那種如釋重負的感覺真的很難描述。)
The museum marks the historical event every year, inviting survivors to share their memories with groups of younger visitors. (博物館每年紀念這起歷史事件，邀請倖存者與一群群年輕訪客分享記憶。)
My phone ran out of battery halfway through the journey, so I missed the call. (我的手機在路程中途沒電，因此漏接了那通電話。)
The table below compares the cost of living in five major cities. (下表比較五個主要城市的生活成本。)
The local library has become a meeting place for the whole community. (當地圖書館已成為整個社區的聚會場所。)
The pipeline carries gas directly across the mountains, supplying several remote towns that have no other winter fuel. (這條管線直接輸送天然氣穿越山區，供應幾個沒有其他冬季燃料的偏遠城鎮。)
The club president resigned unexpectedly after the dispute, leaving the committee to choose a temporary replacement before June. (爭議過後，俱樂部主席意外辭職，委員會必須在六月前選出臨時接任者。)
Social media plays an important role in shaping the opinions of young voters. (社群媒體在形塑年輕選民觀點上扮演重要角色。)
That particular treatment works well for adults, but it has not yet been properly tested on young children. (那種特定療程對成人效果很好，但尚未在幼童身上做過妥善測試。)
The contract is long, but the important details are on page three. (合約很長，但重要細節在第三頁。)
The company lost sensitive personal customer data, and the incident was not properly reported publicly for several weeks. (這家公司遺失敏感的顧客個人資料，這起事件有好幾週都未妥善公開通報。)
The repair shop made no extra charge for the small adjustment, which pleased the customer greatly. (修理店沒有對這項小調整收取額外費用，令顧客非常高興。)
Each individual cell in the sample was carefully photographed, allowing researchers to clearly compare healthy and damaged tissue. (樣本中每個細胞都經過仔細拍攝，讓研究人員能清楚比較健康與受損組織。)
The new manager improved customer service within a few months, although staff still complain about low pay. (新經理幾個月內改善了客服品質，但員工仍不斷抱怨薪資太低。)

meaning: adj. 經濟上的；經濟相關的
example: Many young people leave for economic reasons, even though their home town offers a quieter and cheaper life. (許多年輕人基於經濟理由離開，儘管家鄉提供更安靜、更便宜的生活。)
Many residents regard the old market as the heart of the neighbourhood. (許多居民把這座老市場視為社區的核心。)
She travels abroad twice a year for work and always takes hand luggage. (她每年出國出差兩次，而且總是只帶手提行李。)
Their approach to the problem was refreshingly practical, focusing on small everyday changes rather than costly complete redesigns. (他們處理這個問題的方法實際得令人耳目一新，著重日常小改變而非昂貴的全面重新設計。)
A surprising amount of rain fell in just two hours, which flooded the lower streets of the town. (短短兩小時內降下驚人數量的雨，淹沒了小鎮地勢較低的街道。)
Children draw pictures of their families and explain who appears in each one. (孩子們畫出家人的圖畫，並說明每幅畫裡有誰。)
The walls are painted white, which reflects the sunlight into the hallway. (牆壁漆成白色，把陽光反射進走廊。)
Building work on the site stopped after workers found ancient stone remains. (工人在工地發現古代石造遺跡後，工程就停工了。)

meaning: v. 使恢復知覺；使甦醒
example: The smell of hot soup soon brought her around after she fainted. (她昏倒後，熱湯的氣味很快讓她恢復了意識。)
The committee held another round of talks to resolve the long-running dispute. (委員會舉行另一輪會談，以解決這場長期的爭議。)
Thousands of families claim monthly housing benefit, yet the application process often remains very slow and confusing. (數千個家庭申請每月住房補助，但申請流程往往仍非常緩慢且令人困惑。)
The first step in the process is to collect reliable data from local clinics. (這個流程的第一步是從地方診所蒐集可靠的資料。)
Each patient receives a leaflet explaining the treatment and the possible side effects. (每位病人都會拿到一份說明治療方式和可能副作用的單張。)
The private clinic offers a wide range of treatments, from simple physiotherapy to surgery for serious joint problems. (這家私人診所提供各式各樣的療程，從簡單的物理治療到嚴重關節問題的手術都有。)
Nearly forty percent of local households now recycle food waste every week. (現在有近四成的當地家庭每週回收廚餘。)
The organization provides free legal advice to refugees and helps them find housing. (這個組織為難民提供免費法律諮詢，並協助他們找到住處。)
Citizens will vote on the controversial proposal in a national referendum next spring. (公民將在明年春天的全國公投中對這項爭議提案投票。)
The council has introduced several measures to reduce traffic near primary schools. (議會已推出幾項措施，以減少小學附近的交通量。)
Trade between the two neighbouring countries has increased steadily since the border reopened. (邊界重新開放後，這兩個鄰國之間的貿易穩定成長。)
The evidence was too incomplete; therefore, the judge refused to reach a final verdict so quickly. (證據太不完整，因此法官拒絕如此匆促地下最終判決。)
After three delays, the train finally arrived at the platform just after midnight. (經過三次延誤，火車終於在午夜過後抵達月台。)
The school raised its entrance requirements after receiving a record number of applications. (學校在收到創紀錄的申請件數後，提高了入學要求。)
The tourism industry provides work for thousands of local families in the region. (觀光產業為該地區數千個本地家庭提供工作。)
The teacher explained the task twice, but some students still looked confused. (老師解釋了兩次任務內容，但有些學生看起來仍一頭霧水。)
The quality of air in the city has improved since diesel buses were replaced. (自從柴油公車汰換後，這座城市的空氣品質已改善。)
His account of the accident does not accord with the evidence from the cameras. (他對事故的說法與監視器拍到的證據不一致。)
The outside of the old building needs repainting after years of strong sun. (這棟老建築的外面經過多年強烈日照，需要重新粉刷。)
I wish the library stayed open later during the examination period in June. (我希望圖書館在六月考試期間能開得晚一點。)
The death of the old tree left a large empty space in the garden. (那棵老樹枯死後，花園裡留下了一大片空位。)
The restoration project attracted hundreds of volunteers, who cleared weeds and rebuilt a short stretch of old railway. (這項修復專案吸引數百名志工，他們清除雜草並重建了一小段舊鐵路。)
A sudden rise in temperature can be an early sign of infection in young children. (體溫突然上升可能是幼童感染的早期徵兆。)
Regular adult smokers face a much higher risk of serious heart disease than non-smokers. (有規律吸菸習慣的成年人罹患嚴重心臟病的風險遠高於不吸菸者。)
The total cost of the project has risen by nearly thirty percent. (這個計畫的總成本已上漲將近三成。)
The retired couple opened a small café after leaving the city, and it soon became popular with local workers. (這對退休夫婦離開城市後開了一家小咖啡館，很快就受到當地勞工歡迎。)
The council published a list of streets where parking will be restricted. (議會公布了一份將限制停車的街道一覽表。)
The harbour expansion gave local firms an opportunity to win overseas contracts. (港口擴建讓本地企業有機會贏得海外合約。)
The government must now act quickly to reduce harmful air pollution in the largest cities. (政府現在必須迅速行動，減少大城市的有害空氣汙染。)
Access to education remains unequal between rural and urban areas of the country. (該國城鄉之間的教育機會仍然不平等。)
One clear benefit of working from home regularly is that employees save both commuting time and a considerable amount of money. (規律居家辦公的一項明顯益處，是員工同時省下通勤時間和可觀的金錢。)
The school's standard of teaching has improved since experienced staff began closely mentoring newly qualified colleagues every week. (自從資深教師每週密切指導新進教師後，這所學校的教學水準便提升了。)
At this early stage, the project still needs approval, funding and a suitable building site near the river. (在這個早期階段，這項專案仍需要核准、資金和河邊一塊合適的建築用地。)
His exam performance suffered, mainly because he had slept very little the night before. (他的考試表現受了影響，主要是因為前一晚睡眠不足。)
Local culture is celebrated in the festival through music, food and dance. (這個節慶透過音樂、食物和舞蹈慶祝當地文化。)
Drivers must focus on the road in thick fog, since visibility can fall dramatically within seconds. (駕駛在濃霧中必須專注於路面，因為能見度可能在幾秒內大幅下降。)
The delayed train will arrive at platform four in about ten more minutes. (誤點的火車大約再十分鐘就會抵達第四月台。)

meaning: adj. 到期應還的；預定應交的
example: The borrowed library book is due back on Friday, but she has not quite finished reading it yet. (借來的圖書館書週五到期應還，但她還沒完全讀完。)
Digital technology has changed how people shop, bank and communicate with friends. (數位科技改變了人們購物、理財和與朋友溝通的方式。)
The field has been left uncultivated for years and is now full of wild flowers. (這片原野已荒廢多年，現在長滿野花。)
The clinic provides useful reading material for waiting patients, which makes the long queues feel much less frustrating. (診所為候診病人提供實用的閱讀材料，讓漫長的排隊感覺不那麼令人挫折。)
The current situation is unsatisfactory, so the committee will review funding for rural transport next month. (目前情況令人不滿意，因此委員會下月將檢討鄉村交通的經費。)

The cathedral was built in the twelfth century and still holds daily services. (這座大教堂建於十二世紀，至今仍每天舉行禮拜。)
Careful analysis of the local river samples revealed traces of pesticide, prompting officials to warn nearby farmers immediately. (仔細分析當地河水樣本後發現農藥殘留，促使官員立即警告附近農民。)
The doctor advised him to limit the amount of salt in his diet. (醫師建議他限制飲食中的鹽分攝取量。)
There is clear evidence of ancient settlement here, including tools and the remains of a small stone wall. (這裡有古代定居的明確證據，包括工具和一道小石牆的殘跡。)

The small flat is designed for a single person or a young couple. (這間小公寓是為單身者或年輕夫妻設計的。)
It is common for students to feel nervous before their first public presentation. (學生在第一次公開報告前感到緊張是很普通的。)
The former international champion now quietly coaches young local teenagers, although she rarely talks about her own successes. (這位前國際冠軍現在默默指導當地青少年，儘管她很少談起自己的成就。)
The two plans are similar in cost but differ in the number of parking spaces. (這兩項計畫成本相似，但停車位數量不同。)
The report clearly addresses the widening gap between rich and poor schools but unfortunately offers few practical solutions. (這份報告清楚處理了貧富學校之間日益擴大的差距，可惜幾乎沒有提出實際的解決方案。)
The room fell into complete silence when the stranger mentioned the missing letter. (那位陌生人提到失蹤的信件時，房間裡陷入完全的寂靜。)
The heating system functions well, but the controls are difficult to understand. (暖氣系統運作良好，但控制面板很難理解。)
Cost is an important factor in the decision, but passenger safety must come first. (成本是這項決定中的重要因素，但乘客安全必須優先。)
The scholarship gives talented students a chance to study at a top university. (這項獎學金讓優秀學生有機會進入頂尖大學就讀。)
She mentioned the serious staffing problem twice, but the manager deliberately and quietly changed the subject both times. (她兩次提到嚴重的人手問題，但經理兩次都刻意悄悄轉移話題。)
Regular daily contact with nature clearly improves mood, yet many city children increasingly spend their entire weekends indoors. (每天規律接觸大自然明顯能改善情緒，但許多城市孩子越來越把整個週末花在室內。)
Scientists believe several unknown creatures may still exist in the deepest ocean, far below the reach of sunlight. (科學家相信最深的海裡可能仍存在幾種未知生物，遠在陽光到不了的地方。)
The response to the public flood appeal was generous, with donations arriving from towns hundreds of miles away. (民眾對水災募款的反應很踴躍，捐款也從數百英里外的城鎮送來。)
Demand for bottled water soared during the heatwave, and several local supermarkets ran out completely within a few hours. (熱浪期間瓶裝水需求暴增，好幾家當地超市幾小時內就完全售罄。)
Public opinion has shifted in favour of stricter rules on plastic waste. (民意已轉向支持對塑膠垃圾採取更嚴格的規定。)
Visitors can pick their own apples in the orchard throughout the autumn. (秋天時，訪客可以在果園裡自己摘蘋果。)
The parcel was delivered to the wrong address and returned two days later. (包裹被送到錯誤的地址，兩天後被退回。)
Local restaurants must apply for a new licence, which usually takes several months to process. (當地餐廳必須申請新執照，而處理過程通常要花上好幾個月。)
It is difficult to compare local hospitals fairly, because they simply treat patients with very different needs and budgets. (要公平比較當地醫院很困難，因為它們服務的病人需求和預算差異很大。)
Scientists suppose the storm will gradually weaken by Friday, although coastal residents are wisely preparing for the worst. (科學家推測風暴到週五會逐漸減弱，不過沿海居民仍明智地為最壞情況做準備。)
Family structure has changed greatly in recent decades, and more grandparents now help with daily childcare. (家庭結構近幾十年來變化很大，越來越多祖父母如今分擔日常托育。)
The report relates the decline in fish to pollution from nearby factories. (這份報告把魚群減少與附近工廠的汙染連結起來。)
The phone's standout feature is its battery, which actually lasts two full days even with constant heavy use. (這支手機最突出的特色是電池，即使持續重度使用，實際上也能撐滿兩天。)
She joined a small engineering firm, quickly earning respect for her practical designs. (她加入一家小型工程公司，很快因實用設計贏得尊重。)
Losing weight requires sustained effort, yet small changes in daily habits often matter more than strict diets alone. (減重需要持續努力，但日常習慣的小改變往往比單靠嚴格節食更重要。)
The river is an important source of drinking water for nearby towns. (這條河是附近城鎮重要的飲用水來源。)

Always check the bill carefully, because some restaurants sometimes add extra items that nobody at the table ordered. (一定要仔細檢查帳單，因為有些餐廳有時會多列桌上沒有人點的東西。)
He paid by cheque because the small shop still did not accept credit cards. (他用支票付款，因為那家小店仍不接受信用卡。)
The campaign against single-use plastic began in one school, but it soon spread to shops across the entire district. (反對一次性塑膠的活動從一所學校開始，但很快擴展到全區的商店。)
Learning at least one foreign language can improve career prospects and deepen cultural understanding. (至少學會一種外國語言，能改善職涯前景並加深文化理解。)
The campaign drew public attention to loneliness among older men, and local groups soon began offering weekly lunches. (這場活動讓大眾關注年長男性的孤獨問題，地方團體很快開始提供每週共餐。)
Setting personal goals can improve motivation, but only if the targets remain realistic and are reviewed every few months. (設定個人目標能提升動力，但前提是目標保持務實，且每隔幾個月檢視一次。)
The final grammar section was particularly difficult, so many candidates ran out of time. (最後的文法部分特別難，因此許多考生時間不夠用。)
Practical knowledge of first aid can save lives in a serious emergency. (實用的急救知識能在緊急情況下救人一命。)
Many packaged snacks contain hidden salt and sugar, so shoppers should carefully read the labels before buying anything. (許多包裝零食含有隱藏的鹽和糖，因此購物者買任何東西前都應仔細閱讀標示。)
The official report will be published only after the election is completely over. (官方報告要等選舉完全結束後才會公布。)
The high court will hear the complex case again in early September this year. (高等法院將在今年九月初再次審理這起複雜案件。)

The sports section of the local newspaper is longer than the news pages, which annoys some older readers. (地方報紙的體育版比新聞版還長，這讓一些較年長的讀者很反感。)
I need to finish the report before the meeting starts on Monday. (我需要在星期一會議開始前完成報告。)
The company was fined heavily for dumping untreated waste into the local river. (這家公司因把未處理廢棄物排入當地河川而被重罰。)
The small store on the corner sells fresh bread, milk, newspapers and sweets. (轉角的小商店賣新鮮麵包、牛奶、報紙和糖果。)
The report is a fierce attack on the policy, arguing that it wasted a great deal of public money. (這份報告對該政策提出猛烈抨擊，主張它浪費了大量公帑。)
The shop checked its remaining stock before promising to deliver the sofa. (店家先查看剩餘庫存，才承諾運送沙發。)
She prepared for the exam by testing herself daily, which reduced much of her anxiety before the final week. (她每天自我測驗來準備考試，這在最後一週前消除了她大半的焦慮。)
The manager decided to fire two employees who had repeatedly ignored safety rules. (經理決定解僱兩名屢次忽視安全規定的員工。)
The police closed the road while they investigated the cause of the crash. (警方在調查車禍原因的期間封閉了道路。)
A recent study found that young people sleep less than their parents did. (最近一項研究發現，年輕人睡得比父母那一輩少。)

The famous painting represents a busy harbour, though the artist never actually visited the coast during his lifetime. (這幅名畫呈現一個繁忙的港口，不過畫家生前其實從未到過海邊。)
Economic growth has slowed this year, although national unemployment remains relatively low overall. (今年經濟增長放緩，但全國失業率整體仍相對偏低。)
Noise from the nearby airport affects residents' sleep, especially for those living closest to the busy flight path. (附近機場的噪音影響居民的睡眠，尤其是住得最靠近繁忙航道的人。)
They established a small local charity to repair bicycles, giving unused bikes to students who cannot afford transport. (他們成立了一個小型地方慈善組織來修理腳踏車，把閒置的車送給付不起交通費的學生。)
I wonder why the council chose that expensive design, when a simpler one would have cost far less. (我想知道市議會為何選擇那個昂貴的設計，明明更簡單的方案會便宜得多。)

Scientists developed a new method for testing water quality in remote areas. (科學家開發出一種在偏遠地區檢測水質的新方法。)
They purchased a small family flat near the busy station, hoping to avoid a long daily commute entirely. (他們在車站附近買了一間小公寓，希望能完全避免每天長途通勤。)
All that stuff in the garage should be taken to the recycling centre. (車庫裡那些東西都應該送到回收中心。)
You should drink plenty of water during long flights to avoid headaches. (長途飛行時應該多喝水，以免頭痛。)

meaning: adj. 私立的；私人經營的
example: Private clinics often charge considerably more, yet many wealthy patients still choose them because waiting times are shorter. (私人診所收費往往高得多，但許多富裕病人仍選擇它們，因為等候時間較短。)
The committee will carefully determine eligibility for the grant, using official income records and proof of local residence. (委員會將仔細判定補助資格，依據官方收入紀錄和本地居住證明。)
The influence of social media on teenage sleep has worried doctors for years, yet parents often underestimate it. (社群媒體對青少年睡眠的影響已讓醫師擔憂多年，但家長往往低估了它。)

Coding has become a basic skill for many jobs outside the technology sector. (寫程式已成為科技業以外許多工作的基本技能。)

The economy grew slowly last year because exports fell sharply in the final quarter. (去年經濟成長緩慢，因為出口在最後一季大幅下滑。)

meaning: adj. 各種各樣的；不同的
example: People volunteer for various reasons, from gaining new experience to simply meeting local neighbours in a friendly setting. (人們當志工的理由各種各樣，從獲得新經驗到單純在友善的環境中認識鄰居都有。)

All applications are kept in a secure file for at least five years. (所有申請文件都會存放在安全檔案中至少五年。)
The department of transport is reviewing the safety of the old river bridge. (交通部門正在重新評估那座老河橋的安全性。)
She asked a direct question and received a clear answer from the manager. (她問了一個直接的問題，得到經理清楚的回答。)

All visitors must enter through the north gate and show their tickets clearly. (所有訪客都必須由北門進入，並清楚出示門票。)
The two sides finally reached an agreement on the sharing of water resources. (雙方終於就水資源分配達成協議。)

The class held a lively discussion about whether advertising should be banned in schools. (班上熱烈討論學校裡是否應禁止廣告。)
Most visitors immediately associate this old market with the smell of warm fresh bread and very strong coffee. (多數訪客會立刻把這座老市場和溫熱新鮮麵包及濃烈咖啡的氣味聯想在一起。)
I hardly recognized the square after they removed all the old trees. (他們把老樹全移走後，我幾乎認不出這個廣場。)
Employers increasingly recognise the value of good mental health support for staff. (雇主越來越認可為員工提供良好心理健康支援的價值。)
The factory closed last year, causing the loss of nearly four hundred local jobs. (這家工廠去年關閉，造成當地近四百個工作機會流失。)
The teacher will mark the essays over the weekend and return them on Monday. (老師會在週末批改作文，並在星期一發回。)
The winter climb is a serious physical challenge, so always prepare carefully and never go alone. (冬季攀登是嚴峻的體能挑戰，因此一定要仔細準備，且絕不要獨自前往。)
Whether the harvest succeeds depends increasingly on the weather, so farmers now pay for accurate detailed summer forecasts. (收成能否成功越來越取決於天氣，因此農民現在願意付費取得準確詳細的夏季預報。)
Engineers proposed a simple long-term solution to the noise problem, but many residents doubt it will actually work. (工程師對噪音問題提出簡單的長期解決辦法，但許多居民懷疑它真能奏效。)
The hospital board approved the budget cuts despite objections from senior nurses and doctors. (儘管資深護理師和醫師提出反對意見，醫院委員會仍通過了預算削減案。)
They plan to marry next spring in the village where they met. (他們打算明年春天在相識的村莊結婚。)
The direct relation between pay and job satisfaction is still often far weaker than many experienced managers tend to assume. (薪資與工作滿意度之間的直接關係，仍往往遠比許多資深主管以為的還要弱。)
The theory sounds fully convincing, yet no single experiment has ever produced evidence strong enough to support it. (這個理論聽起來完全有說服力，但從沒有任何單一實驗產生足以支持它的證據。)
Despite a painful knee injury, she finished the marathon and even slightly improved on her previous best time. (儘管膝傷疼痛，她仍跑完馬拉松，甚至略微刷新自己先前的最佳成績。)
The council introduced a new fee for household garden waste, which sharply reduced illegal dumping within just a few weeks. (市議會對家庭庭園廢棄物收取新費用，短短幾週內就大幅減少非法傾倒。)
The results prove that early treatment greatly improves a patient's chances of survival. (結果證明，及早治療能大幅提高病患的存活機會。)
Her ability to stay calm under pressure impressed the senior coach, who had doubted her before the match. (她在壓力下保持冷靜的能力讓資深教練印象深刻，這位教練賽前還曾懷疑她。)
The hospital has modern equipment and a new unit for heart patients. (這家醫院有現代化的設備，還有一間新的心臟病患專用病房。)
The doctor advised him to reduce salt and take more regular exercise. (醫生建議他減少鹽分攝取，並多做規律運動。)
The government released the full report on Friday, quietly hoping fewer people would notice its clearly embarrassing conclusions. (政府在週五公布完整報告，悄悄希望較少人注意到其中明顯令人難堪的結論。)
His score improved after he changed his grip, though he still lost the final match by two points. (他改變握拍方式後分數進步了，不過仍在決賽以兩分之差落敗。)

meaning: n. 取得的機會；使用權
example: Rural children often lack access to good local schools, so many families move closer to the nearest town. (鄉村孩子往往缺乏就讀良好本地學校的管道，因此許多家庭搬到最近的城鎮附近。)
The annual conference brings together researchers from more than thirty different countries. (年度會議聚集來自三十多個不同國家的研究人員。)
The team was ready to present its findings after weeks of careful preparation. (經過數週仔細準備，團隊已準備好發表研究結果。)
A three-week strike by rail workers left thousands of commuters without a way to work. (鐵路員工罷工三週，讓數千名通勤族沒有交通工具可以上班。)
The school met its annual reading target, but still fell surprisingly short in mathematics despite weekly extra lessons. (這所學校達成了年度閱讀目標，但儘管每週加課，數學表現仍出乎意料地未達標。)
Teachers often underestimate the genuine potential of quieter students, who may produce more thoughtful work when given time. (教師常低估安靜學生的真正潛力，這些學生只要有時間，往往能交出更有深度的作品。)
Neighbours organized a street party to welcome the families who had recently arrived. (鄰居籌辦了一場街頭派對，歡迎最近搬來的家庭。)
The tiles form a pattern of blue stars on a white background. (磁磚在白底上排成藍色星星的樣式。)
The movement for cleaner rivers has gained support from local businesses and schools. (爭取河川潔淨的運動已獲得當地企業和學校的支持。)
The council proposed turning the empty warehouse into flats, but engineers warned that the roof needed repairs first. (市議會提議把空倉庫改成住宅，但工程師警告屋頂必須先修繕。)
Many people have a fear of speaking in front of a large audience. (許多人害怕在大批觀眾面前說話。)
She needed an operation on her knee and stayed in hospital for four days. (她的膝蓋需要動手術，因此住院四天。)
She tripped over a loose cable and dropped the tray of glasses. (她被一條鬆脫的電線絆倒，手上的玻璃杯托盤也掉了。)
The supply chain suddenly broke down, so local shops ran out of essential goods within two days. (供應鏈突然中斷，當地商店兩天內就賣光基本必需品。)
Her job application was very strong, yet the panel finally chose someone with considerably more relevant practical experience. (她的求職申請很出色，但評審最後選了具備更多相關實務經驗的人。)
The rail network is being upgraded to cope with rising passenger numbers. (鐵路網正在升級，以因應不斷增加的乘客量。)
The company needs a clear strategy for reducing its dependence on coal. (公司需要明確的策略來減少對煤炭的依賴。)
The recorded interview lasted an hour, yet the journalist published only two brief sentences from the entire conversation. (錄音訪談進行了一小時，記者卻只刊登整段對話中的兩個簡短句子。)
The nearest hospital is forty minutes away by ambulance from this village. (從這個村莊搭救護車到最近的醫院要四十分鐘。)
Her husband works as a civil engineer at a company outside the city. (她丈夫在城外一家公司擔任土木工程師。)
A degree in economics is no longer a guarantee of a well-paid job. (經濟學學位已不再是高薪工作的保證。)
The restaurant has won several awards for its use of fresh local ingredients. (這家餐廳因使用新鮮在地食材而獲得數個獎項。)
The author spent five years interviewing families affected by the factory closure. (作者花了五年訪問受工廠關閉影響的家庭。)
The pressure at work suddenly increased again, so she eventually asked for two weeks of much-needed unpaid leave. (工作壓力又突然增加，因此她最後申請了兩週亟需的無薪假。)
Several parents expressed concern about the new timetable, so the school arranged a public meeting in the hall. (幾位家長對新課表表達擔憂，因此學校在大禮堂安排了一場公開說明會。)
Fierce competition at the flower show pushed gardeners to breed increasingly unusual roses, fascinating visitors. (花展的激烈競爭促使園藝家培育越來越奇特的玫瑰，讓參觀者著迷。)

meaning: n. 推薦信；推薦人評語
example: Landlords often ask for a written reference from a previous landlord, which makes moving to the city difficult for newcomers. (房東常要求提供前任房東的書面推薦，讓初來城市的人很難搬進城裡。)
My aunt took us to the coast and treated us to lunch by the harbour. (阿姨帶我們去海邊，並請我們在港邊吃午餐。)
The argument's conclusion was clear, yet the supporting evidence remained surprisingly weak. (論證的結論很清楚，但支持它的證據仍出乎意料地薄弱。)
Family doctors now recommend natural remedies only when scientific evidence shows that they are truly safe and effective. (家庭醫師現在只有在科學證據顯示自然療法真正安全有效時，才會建議使用。)
The story touched everyone in the room, and several people began to cry. (這個故事觸動了房裡每一個人，好幾個人開始落淚。)
The demand for evening classes went beyond what the college had expected, forcing it to hire more tutors. (夜間課程的需求超出學院的預期，迫使學院聘請更多教師。)
The report defines poverty in terms of income, health and adequate housing. (這份報告從收入、健康和適足住房來界定貧窮。)
Local rents are reviewed on a yearly basis, which gives tenants little protection when prices often rise suddenly. (當地租金每年檢討一次，這讓房客在價格突然上漲時幾乎沒有保障。)
Solar energy now powers thousands of homes and small businesses in the region. (太陽能現在為該地區數千戶家庭和小型企業供電。)
Local fishermen catch enough fish to supply the small restaurants along the coast. (當地漁民捕的魚足以供應沿海的小餐館。)
The nurse took a small blood sample, which was quickly sent to the nearby laboratory for immediate testing. (護理師抽取少量血液樣本，迅速送到附近實驗室立即檢驗。)
The new report refers to rapidly falling birth rates but says little about how local schools should respond. (這份新報告提到生育率快速下降，卻很少談到地方學校該如何因應。)
The early trial produced unexpectedly positive results, though doctors still remain cautious because the sample was very small. (早期試驗出現意外正面的結果，不過醫師仍保持謹慎，因為樣本數非常少。)
The express train usually runs daily except on national holidays, when a slower direct bus service replaces it. (這班特快車通常每天行駛，國定假日除外，屆時會由較慢的直達巴士取代。)
The company broke its promise to protect the forest, and local residents have refused to trust it since. (這家公司違背保護森林的承諾，當地居民從此拒絕再信任它。)
The disease spread quickly through the crowded camp before clean water arrived. (乾淨的水送達前，這種疾病在擁擠的營地裡迅速傳播。)
She wore a long blue dress to the ceremony and matching shoes. (她穿了一件藍色長洋裝和相配的鞋子出席典禮。)
Spectators are not allowed to throw objects onto the pitch during a match. (比賽期間，觀眾不得把物品投擲到球場上。)
Property prices near the new station have risen much faster than local wages. (新車站附近的房地產價格，漲幅遠超過當地薪資。)
The plant operates around the clock to meet demand for bottled water. (這座工廠全天候運轉，以滿足瓶裝水的需求。)
The bus company made a profit last year, but it still plans to raise fares and cut rural routes. (這家公車公司去年有獲利，卻仍計畫調漲票價並裁減鄉村路線。)
Her first goal was to run a full local marathon, and she quietly trained for almost eighteen months. (她的第一個目標是跑完一場當地全程馬拉松，而她默默訓練了將近十八個月。)
The small hotel bar stayed open late, serving drinks to a few tired guests after the wedding had ended. (小型飯店酒吧營業到很晚，在婚禮結束後為幾位疲倦的賓客供應飲料。)
Tickets must be booked well in advance, especially during the summer holidays. (尤其是在暑假期間，票一定要提早預訂。)
Local fishermen strongly object to the wind farm, arguing that it will seriously disrupt their daily fishing routes. (當地漁民強烈反對這座風力發電場，主張它會嚴重干擾他們每日的漁撈路線。)
The building was designed in a simple style that uses plenty of natural light. (這棟建築以簡約風格設計，大量運用自然光。)
People tend to overestimate how quickly they can finish a task, which causes unnecessary stress and missed deadlines. (人們往往高估自己完成任務的速度，這造成不必要的壓力和錯過的期限。)
Doctors often assume that patients regularly take their medicine as prescribed, yet studies show that many simply forget. (醫師常假定病人會按指示規律服藥，但研究顯示許多人只是忘了吃。)
Returning to normal working hours helped him sleep better, although he still felt tired for the first week. (恢復正常工作時間後，他睡得比較好，儘管第一週仍覺得疲倦。)

meaning: v. 受損；遭受不利影響
example: Local shops suffer badly when roadworks block the narrow pavement, even if the work eventually brings more customers. (路面施工擋住狹窄人行道時，當地店家生意大受影響，即使工程最終會帶來更多顧客。)
The two universities exchange teaching materials and run a joint summer programme. (這兩所大學交流教材，並合辦暑期課程。)
The match was abandoned after sudden heavy rain, so disappointed fans received a full refund for their tickets. (比賽因突如其來的大雨取消，失望的球迷獲得全額退票。)
Surgeons use a simple checklist to avoid common careless mistakes, especially during long routine operations late at night. (外科醫師用簡單檢查表避免常見的粗心錯誤，尤其是在深夜的長時間例行手術中。)
The still lake reflects the snowy mountains so clearly that it looks like a giant mirror. (平靜的湖面清晰映出雪山，看起來就像一面巨大的鏡子。)
The treasure hunt was great fun, and every child won a small prize. (尋寶活動很好玩，每個孩子都贏得一個小獎品。)
In one instance, a faulty alarm delayed the evacuation by twenty minutes. (有一次，故障的警報器讓疏散延誤了二十分鐘。)
Keep your important travel documents in a safe place, since replacing a lost passport normally takes several days. (把重要旅行文件放在安全的地方，因為補辦遺失護照通常要花好幾天。)
The strongest argument for change is simply cost, since the old system wastes both money and staff time. (支持改變最有力的理由就是成本，因為舊制度既浪費金錢也浪費員工時間。)

meaning: n. 資源；可運用的條件
example: Time is a limited resource in every classroom, so teachers must decide which activities deserve the most attention. (時間是每個教室裡有限的資源，因此教師必須決定哪些活動最值得投入。)
The new sports facility is open to all local residents at weekends. (新的運動設施週末開放給所有本地居民使用。)

meaning: prep. 遍及；在整個範圍內
example: Rural clinics throughout the island now offer free screening, although waiting times remain long in remote villages. (全島各地的鄉村診所現在都提供免費篩檢，不過偏遠村莊的等候時間仍很長。)
Parliament will debate the new housing bill for two days before voting on it. (國會將針對新住宅法案辯論兩天，然後進行表決。)
Please separate the glass bottles from the paper before putting them outside. (請把玻璃瓶和紙張分開，再放到外面。)
Each candidate was asked to explain clearly how their previous experience would help them handle the demanding role. (每位求職者都被要求清楚說明，他們先前的經驗會如何幫助他們勝任這份要求很高的工作。)
Nurses earn far less than many people imagine, given the responsibility they carry. (考慮到護理師承擔的責任，他們賺的遠比許多人想像的少。)
The villagers struggle to maintain the old bridge, as repair costs rise sharply every year. (村民努力維護這座老橋，因為修繕費每年都急劇上升。)
She took a two-year career break, returning to full-time nursing at the local hospital when her children started primary school. (她暫停職涯兩年，等孩子上小學後回到當地醫院擔任全職護理工作。)
The government plans to spend two billion dollars on new railway lines. (政府計畫在新建鐵路線上花費二十億美元。)
There is some doubt about whether the bridge will be finished this year. (這座橋能否在今年完工，仍有些不確定。)
Regular exercise improves mood, sleep quality and general health in people of all ages. (規律運動能改善各年齡層的心情、睡眠品質和整體健康。)
Her previous job was far more stressful, although it still paid much better than her current one. (她以前的工作壓力大得多，儘管薪水仍比現在這份好很多。)
Her daily walk to the office takes about twenty minutes each way. (她每天走路到辦公室，單程大約二十分鐘。)
Basic hygiene measures, such as regular hand washing, prevent many common infections. (基本的衛生措施，例如經常洗手，能預防許多常見感染。)
Her calm manner is a great asset when customers start to complain. (客人開始抱怨時，她沉穩的態度是一大優勢。)
The orchestra will perform in the park on Sunday, provided the weather remains dry and the wind stays calm. (只要天氣保持乾燥、風勢平穩，樂團星期天將在公園演出。)
Keeping a strict balance between full-time study and part-time work proved much harder than she had originally expected. (在全職學業與打工之間維持嚴格的平衡，比她原先預期的還要難得多。)
Free fruit in schools encourages children to try new foods, although habits at home matter just as much. (學校提供免費水果能鼓勵孩子嘗試新食物，不過家裡的飲食習慣同樣重要。)
Coastal wetlands protect the land from serious flooding during severe winter storms. (沿海濕地在強烈冬季風暴期間保護陸地免於嚴重水患。)
The scandal caused lasting damage to the company's reputation, frightening away several major investors. (這起醜聞對公司名譽造成長久損害，嚇跑好幾位主要投資人。)
It is difficult to imagine modern city life without cars, yet planners believe it is entirely possible. (很難想像沒有汽車的現代城市生活，但規劃者相信這完全可能。)
Engineers estimate the final renovation will cost far more than the council originally promised voters. (工程師估計最後的整修費用將遠高於地方議會原先向選民承諾的金額。)
The remark sounded rude, but in context it was clearly meant as a joke. (那句話聽起來很無禮，但從上下文來看，顯然只是玩笑。)
Much of the credit for the discovery belongs to a young researcher who noticed a faint pattern in the data. (這項發現的大部分功勞歸於一位年輕研究員，他注意到數據中一個微弱的規律。)
The latest version of the software fixes several bugs but also removes a popular feature. (最新版軟體修正了幾個錯誤，但也移除了一項受歡迎的功能。)
The festival offers a variety of performances, from street acrobatics to quiet readings in the small local library. (這個節慶提供各式各樣的表演，從街頭特技到當地小圖書館裡的靜態朗讀都有。)
She applied to extend her student visa, but the office officially warned that processing could take several weeks. (她申請延長學生簽證，但辦事處正式警告處理可能需要好幾週。)
The proposal for a new car park was rejected at the public meeting. (新停車場的提案在公開會議上被否決了。)
They hired a professional photographer for the wedding, although a talented friend offered to do it all for free. (他們請了專業攝影師拍婚禮，儘管一位有才華的朋友主動表示願意免費包辦。)
The copper mine closed in the 1980s, leaving hundreds of people without work. (這座銅礦場在一九八○年代關閉，讓數百人失去工作。)
The nurses' request for extra night staff was finally approved, though the change will only start next month. (護理師要求增加夜班人力的申請終於獲准，不過這項改變下個月才開始。)
The original plan was much simpler, but several unnecessary late changes made the whole project far more expensive. (最初的計畫簡單得多，但幾項不必要的後期變更讓整個專案貴了許多。)
The female engineers on the team designed a lighter frame for the bike. (團隊中的女性工程師設計了更輕的自行車車架。)
Scientists observe the birds from a hidden hut to avoid affecting their behaviour. (科學家從隱蔽的小屋觀察鳥類，以免影響牠們的行為。)
The school informed all parents about the sudden closure, sending messages quickly enough for them to arrange childcare. (學校通知所有家長停課消息，訊息送得夠快，讓他們能安排托育。)
Researchers discovered that the common drug works better when taken in the morning, contrary to widely accepted earlier advice. (研究人員發現這種常見藥物在早上服用效果更好，與先前廣被接受的建議相反。)
The new running track was resurfaced last month, and local athletes now seriously train there almost every evening. (新的田徑跑道上月重新鋪設，當地運動員現在幾乎每晚都在那裡認真訓練。)
All blood donors are carefully screened for infection, which makes transfusions now far safer than they once were. (所有捐血者都經過仔細篩檢感染，這讓輸血現在比以往安全得多。)
The travel agency arranged everything, from flights to insurance, yet it actually forgot to confirm the hotel booking. (旅行社安排好一切，從機票到保險，卻竟然忘了確認飯店訂房。)
Doctors examined the small X-ray carefully but found no fracture, so they simply advised rest instead of surgery. (醫師仔細查看這張小型 X 光片，但沒發現骨折，因此只建議休息，不必動手術。)
Tenants should seek independent legal advice before signing a lease, especially if the terms seem very unusual. (房客在簽租約前應尋求獨立的法律建議，尤其是條款看起來很不尋常時。)
The university has opened a new campus to accommodate growing student numbers. (這所大學啟用新校區，以容納不斷增加的學生人數。)
I recommend the small bakery near the bridge for its warm rye bread. (我推薦橋邊那家小麵包店，它的黑麥麵包是溫熱的。)
Read the directions on the packet before you apply the chemical to the plants. (在把藥劑用在植物上之前，請先閱讀包裝上的用法說明。)
Caring for the river is a shared responsibility, so farmers and factories must both reduce their polluting waste. (照顧這條河是共同責任，因此農民和工廠都必須減少污染性廢棄物。)
Their quiet conversation about local house prices seemed almost endless long after the coffee had gone completely cold. (他們輕聲談著當地房價，咖啡完全涼了很久之後，話題似乎還沒完沒了。)
The magazine publishes a monthly survey of house prices across the country. (這本雜誌每月刊登全國房價調查。)
The band plays rock music, but their latest album includes softer acoustic songs. (這個樂團演奏搖滾樂，但最新專輯收錄了較柔和的原聲歌曲。)

meaning: adj. 獨立的；不受控制的
example: The study was funded by a charity, which allowed the researchers to remain completely independent of industry pressure. (這項研究由慈善機構資助，讓研究人員得以完全獨立於產業壓力。)
The school needs additional funding for new books, yet the council has frozen its budget for three years. (學校需要額外經費買新書，但市議會已凍結預算三年。)
The estate agent showed us four apartments before we chose the smaller one. (房仲帶我們看了四間公寓，我們才選了較小的那一間。)
The machine looks complex, yet most faults can be fixed with a simple screwdriver and a little patience. (這台機器看起來很複雜，但多數故障用一把簡單螺絲起子和一點耐心就能修好。)
It is not appropriate to prescribe antibiotics for every cough, since most infections simply clear up without them. (每個咳嗽都開抗生素並不適當，因為大多數感染不用藥就會自行痊癒。)
They invited all the neighbours to a barbecue in the garden on Saturday afternoon. (他們邀請所有鄰居參加星期六下午在花園舉辦的烤肉。)

meaning: adj. 傳統的；沿襲習俗的
example: Although the town now attracts thousands of tourists, its traditional houses are still occupied by local families who refuse to sell. (這座小鎮現在吸引數千名遊客，傳統房屋仍由不願出售的當地家庭居住。)
Look both ways carefully before you cross the busy road at this junction. (在這個路口穿越繁忙馬路前，請仔細查看兩邊來車。)
She did not reply to the email until the following Monday morning. (她一直到隔週一早上才回覆那封電子郵件。)
The town is famous for its cheese, which is exported to many European countries. (這座小鎮以起司聞名，產品外銷到許多歐洲國家。)
The new software automatically checks long documents for spelling and grammar errors. (新軟體會自動檢查文件中的拼字和文法錯誤。)
The new rice variety performed well in repeated field trials, producing more grain with noticeably less water and fertiliser. (新品種稻米在反覆的田間試驗中表現良好，用明顯較少的水和肥料生產更多穀物。)
Extreme weather has become more frequent, damaging homes and disrupting transport networks. (極端天氣變得更加頻繁，損壞房屋並擾亂交通網路。)

meaning: n. 行政單位；管理部門
example: The university administration promised to answer every application within ten days, but many students still waited much longer. (大學行政單位承諾十天內回覆每份申請，但許多學生仍等了更久。)
A technician came to fix the broken heating before the cold weather arrived. (技術員在天氣轉冷前來修理故障的暖氣。)
The judge reminded the jury to consider only the evidence presented in open court. (法官提醒陪審團只能考慮在公開法庭上提出的證據。)
A surprise element is essential to any truly good ghost story, keeping readers uncertain until the final page. (意外要素對任何真正精彩的鬼故事都不可或缺，能讓讀者不確定到最後一頁。)
The hotel staff welcomed the guests with cold drinks and a short introduction to the area. (飯店員工以冷飲和簡短的地區介紹歡迎客人。)
The judge will announce the final winner at noon, and the prize will be publicly presented immediately afterwards. (評審將在中午宣布最終優勝者，獎項隨後立即公開頒發。)
He poured water into a tall glass and added a slice of lemon. (他把水倒進高玻璃杯，再加了一片檸檬。)
Children carefully stick bright pictures on the classroom wall, and the display quickly changes with every new topic. (孩子們仔細把鮮豔圖片貼在教室牆上，展示內容隨著每個新主題迅速更換。)
A new medical certificate is now a requirement for every single applicant, which has slowed the process considerably. (新的醫療證明現在是每位申請人的必要條件，這讓流程慢了不少。)
Loud laughter came from the kitchen when the cake fell onto the floor. (蛋糕掉到地上時，廚房傳來一陣大笑聲。)
Small class sizes are genuinely effective only when teachers receive regular professional training and adequate planning support each term. (小班制唯有在教師獲得定期專業訓練和足夠備課支援時，才真正有效。)
The staff survey clearly revealed low morale, so managers promised to review workloads before the end of term. (員工調查清楚顯示士氣低落，因此主管承諾在學期結束前檢討工作量。)
Governments that invest in public early education often save considerable money later on healthcare and crime, according to economists. (經濟學家指出，投資公共幼兒教育的政府，日後往往能在醫療和犯罪防治上省下可觀經費。)
The majority of members supported the plan, yet the chair insisted on holding another formal vote next month. (多數成員支持這項計畫，但主席堅持下個月再舉行一次正式表決。)
Tourism is now the primary source of income for the whole island. (觀光現在是整座島的主要收入來源。)
The younger generation now spends far more time online than their parents did at the same age. (年輕一代現在上網的時間，遠比他們的父母在同年紀時多得多。)

meaning: adj. 聯邦的；聯邦政府的
example: Federal funding paid for the new road, but the town maintains it. (新路是用聯邦經費蓋的，但由鎮公所維護。)
Robots may replace routine factory jobs, but they also create new roles that increasingly demand different technical skills. (機器人可能取代例行的工廠工作，但也創造出越來越需要不同技術能力的新職務。)
Serious exam stress often disrupts students' sleep, which can make concentration even harder the following week. (嚴重的考試壓力常打亂學生睡眠，使他們在接下來一週更難專心。)
The club committee voted to rebuild the old changing rooms, but postponed a decision on raising membership fees. (俱樂部委員會表決重建老舊更衣室，但延後決定是否調漲會員費。)
The design follows the principle that natural light should reach every room. (這項設計遵循讓自然光照進每個房間的原則。)
The website content was outdated, so the team rewrote every page before the launch. (網站內容已過時，因此團隊在上線前重寫了每一頁。)
The ambulance arrived immediately after the emergency call, and the crew began treatment before carefully moving the patient. (緊急電話後救護車立刻抵達，救護人員先開始治療，才小心移動病人。)
A growing percentage of graduates now work in jobs unrelated to their degree, according to a recent national survey. (根據最近一項全國調查，現在有越來越高比例的畢業生從事與所學無關的工作。)
The research laboratory bought new equipment for measuring local air and water quality. (研究實驗室採購了新設備，用來測量當地空氣與水質。)
The family kept to a strict holiday budget, cooking most meals themselves and avoiding expensive tourist restaurants. (這家人嚴格遵守度假預算，自己煮大多數餐點，並避開昂貴的觀光客餐廳。)
Employees can transfer to another department after a full year, provided they successfully complete the required internal training. (員工滿一年後可以轉調其他部門，前提是順利完成規定的內部訓練。)
The opening scene shows a busy market at dawn, full of noise and movement. (開場戲呈現黎明時繁忙的市場，充滿喧鬧與動態。)
The doctor's professional conduct was questioned after several patients complained about rude remarks during consultations. (幾位病人抱怨醫師在看診時出言無禮後，他的專業行為受到質疑。)
The health sector now employs more local people than the factories once did. (醫療產業現在雇用的人數，比過去的工廠還多。)
Our team beat the visiting side by two goals in the final minute. (我們隊在最後一分鐘以兩球之差擊敗客隊。)
Warm winters have allowed insects to survive in areas where they once died. (溫暖的冬天讓昆蟲得以在過去會凍死的區域存活。)
Please copy the full report to the finance department before Friday morning. (請在星期五早上前把完整報告複製給財務部門。)
Constant negative news can lower people's mood, even when their own lives remain stable. (持續不斷的負面新聞會拉低人們的情緒，即使他們自己的生活仍相當穩定。)
The annual check-up includes routine blood tests, a hearing check and a short conversation about diet and exercise. (年度健康檢查包括例行抽血、聽力檢查，以及簡短討論飲食與運動。)
Regular and careful hand washing helps prevent the spread of infection in crowded city hospitals. (規律且仔細洗手有助預防感染在擁擠的城市醫院中擴散。)
The new bakery is three blocks away, next to a small post office. (新的麵包店在三個街區外，就在一家小郵局旁邊。)
Monthly online payment is now standard, yet some older local customers still prefer to pay at the counter. (每月線上付款現在已是常態，但一些年長的當地顧客仍偏好到櫃檯付款。)
His carefully kept stamp collection filled twelve old albums, and it was finally donated to a small local museum. (他細心保存的郵票收藏裝滿十二本舊冊，最後捐給一家小型地方博物館。)
Her advice on saving money each month was practical, although it required far more discipline than he had expected. (她關於每月存錢的建議很實際，儘管這需要比他預期更多的自律。)
She entered local politics after years of working for a community organisation. (她在社區組織工作多年後踏入政治。)
Surgeons successfully removed the small tumour, and the anxious patient was able to go home two days later. (外科醫師成功切除小腫瘤，焦慮的病人兩天後就能回家。)
Staff check the equipment twice a day to ensure that patients are never left waiting. (工作人員每天檢查設備兩次，以確保病患不會一直空等。)
Medical students now spend more time in local clinics, which gives them valuable practical experience before they qualify. (醫學生現在花更多時間在當地診所，在取得資格前獲得寶貴的實務經驗。)
They hung the old family picture above the fireplace, where everyone could see it clearly. (他們把那張老家族照片掛在壁爐上方，讓每個人都能清楚看見。)

meaning: adj. 相對的；比較而言的
example: The relative safety of cycling has improved, thanks to new lanes and lower speed limits. (多虧新建自行車道和降低速限，騎自行車的相對安全性已提升。)
Every vote counts in a local election, even in apparently safe seats. (地方選舉中每一票都很重要，即使是在看似穩贏的選區。)

meaning: n. 交通運輸；交通工具
example: Public transport in the valley is limited to two buses a day. (這個山谷的大眾運輸一天只有兩班公車。)
The shop displays handmade local pottery in its window, attracting visitors who rarely enter such small stores. (這家店在櫥窗陳列手工製作的在地陶器，吸引平常很少走進這類小店的訪客。)
The car had a flat front tyre, so we changed it beside the road in the pouring rain. (車子的前輪爆胎，所以我們在傾盆大雨中於路邊換胎。)
The procedure for reporting an accident is posted on the wall of every workshop. (意外通報的程序張貼在每間工作坊的牆上。)
The contrast between the two gardens is striking in the early spring. (早春時，這兩座花園的對比非常明顯。)
Go straight along this road and turn left at the second traffic light. (沿著這條路直走，在第二個紅綠燈左轉。)
Please correct any errors in the report before it is sent out. (報告寄出前，請改正任何錯誤。)
There is a clear connection between city traffic pollution and childhood asthma. (城市交通汙染與兒童氣喘之間有明顯關聯。)
The old hospital became a research institution after the new one opened. (新醫院啟用後，舊醫院成了一所研究機構。)
The chef admitted that he had added too much salt, and offered every table a free dessert as an apology. (主廚承認自己鹽加太多，並免費招待每桌一份甜點作為道歉。)
Consumer confidence fell sharply after news of rising electricity prices quickly spread across the region. (電價上漲的消息在各地迅速傳開後，消費者信心大幅下滑。)
Satellite images revealed that the forest had shrunk dramatically, despite official claims that logging was under strict control. (衛星影像顯示森林大幅縮減，儘管官方聲稱伐木受到嚴格控制。)
We must leave by six, otherwise the heavy traffic will certainly make us late for the opening ceremony. (我們必須六點前出發，否則繁忙的交通一定會讓我們趕不上開幕典禮。)
Many drivers are not aware that idling engines waste fuel, so simple roadside signs could change their habits. (許多駕駛不知道怠速空轉會浪費燃油，因此簡單的路邊標示就能改變他們的習慣。)
The quiet coastal village appeals strongly to remote workers, who value fast internet and a slower daily pace. (這座安靜的海濱村莊強烈吸引遠距工作者，他們重視快速網路和較慢的日常步調。)

meaning: adj. 替代的；其他可選的
example: The island heavily invests in alternative energy, since importing fuel by ship remains very expensive and unreliable. (這座島大力投資替代能源，因為用船進口燃料仍非常昂貴且不可靠。)
The status of the building project changes every week as funding is reviewed. (隨著資金不斷檢討，這項建築計畫的狀況每週都在變。)
He received a local award for bravery, although he modestly insists he simply did what anyone would have done. (他因英勇行為獲得當地獎項，儘管他謙虛地堅稱自己只是做了任何人都會做的事。)
The surface of the moon is covered with fine dust, which forms a thick grey layer over the rock beneath. (月球表面覆蓋著細塵，在底下的岩石上形成厚厚的灰色層。)
She handles difficult customer complaints calmly, even when the callers are rude. (她能冷靜處理難纏的客訴，即使來電者態度無禮。)
The form asks for your name, age, sex, occupation and country of residence. (這份表格要求填寫姓名、年齡、性別、職業和居住國。)
The introduction clearly explains the author's main purpose, but it says little about the evidence actually behind her claims. (導言清楚說明作者的主要目的，但對其主張背後的實際證據著墨不多。)
She delivered her short speech without notes, which impressed the entire audience and quietly silenced the earlier criticism. (她沒看稿就發表了簡短演說，讓全場觀眾印象深刻，也悄悄平息了先前的批評。)
Volunteers collected signatures outside the busy market, hoping to force a public vote on the planned car park. (志工在繁忙的市場外收集簽名，希望促使當局就計畫中的停車場舉行公投。)
The teacher generously gave us extra time, because the exam paper was much longer than expected. (老師慷慨地多給我們時間，因為考卷比預期長得多。)
The council intends to ban cars from the square during the summer months. (市議會打算在夏季期間禁止車輛進入廣場。)
Cheap shoes often wear out quickly and cost far more in the long run. (廉價鞋子常常很快就壞，長期下來反而花更多錢。)
A decade of research has improved early treatment, yet many patients still wait months for a correct diagnosis. (十年的研究改善了早期治療，但許多病人仍要等好幾個月才能獲得正確診斷。)
The judge finally sentenced him to three years in prison for large-scale fraud. (法官最後判他因大規模詐欺入獄三年。)
The study found that participants' overall health improved slightly, although sleep quality remained poor among night-shift workers. (研究發現參與者的整體健康略有改善，儘管夜班工作者的睡眠品質仍然很差。)
Her expression changed suddenly when she heard the shocking news about the accident. (她聽到那起事故的驚人消息時，表情突然改變。)
The concert in the park was free, and hundreds of families came. (公園裡的音樂會免費，來了數百個家庭。)
The new office printer can print double-sided pages to reduce paper use. (新印表機可以雙面列印，以減少紙張用量。)
The responsible journalist checked every fact twice before publishing the story about the old factory. (這位盡責的記者在刊登那座老工廠的報導前，逐一查證了每項事實兩遍。)

meaning:
n. 下降；衰退
v. 下降；衰退；婉拒
example: Wild bee populations have declined sharply, threatening crops that depend on pollination every spring. (野生蜜蜂的數量急遽減少，威脅到每年春季仰賴授粉的作物。)

meaning:
n. 補助金；補助款
vt. 授予；准許
example: The small research grant allowed the laboratory to buy essential new equipment, speeding up experiments considerably. (這筆小額研究補助款讓實驗室得以購買必要的新設備，大幅加快實驗進度。)

meaning:
adj. 身體的；體能的；物理的
n. 體格檢查
example: Teachers report that daily physical activity before lessons helps young pupils concentrate, especially during the long afternoon sessions. (教師表示，年幼學生每天在上課前活動身體，有助於他們專心，尤其是在漫長的下午課程中。)

meaning:
n. 速度；速率
v. 加速；快速行進
example: The speed limit on this narrow road was reduced after several serious accidents. (這條狹窄道路發生幾起嚴重事故後，速限便調降了。)

meaning:
v. 挑選；選出
adj. 精選的；特選的
example: A panel of judges will select the winner from more than fifty entries. (評審小組將從五十多件參賽作品中選出優勝者。)
Your visa application falls into a category that requires two additional documents. (你的簽證申請屬於需要另外提交兩份文件的類別。)

meaning:
adj. 公平的；合理的
n. 展覽會；市集
example: The local club promised a fair selection process after parents complained that places always went to wealthier families. (家長抱怨名額總是給較富裕的家庭後，當地俱樂部承諾採取公平的遴選程序。)
His attitude to risk changed entirely after the accident, and he now avoids driving alone on dark nights. (事故發生後，他對風險的態度徹底改變，現在會避免在漆黑的夜晚獨自開車。)

meaning:
n. 樂團；一群人；帶狀物
vt. 把……分類；給……套上標記
example: A small jazz band played happily at the wedding reception, keeping guests dancing until the lights finally dimmed. (一支小型爵士樂團在婚宴上愉快演奏，讓賓客一直跳舞到燈光終於暗下來。)
Sea turtles return to the same beach each year to lay their eggs. (海龜每年都會回到同一片海灘產卵。)
The report stresses the importance of early diagnosis and regular screening for adults. (報告強調早期診斷及成人定期篩檢的重要性。)

meaning:
adj. 完美的；理想的
v. 使完善；精益求精
example: He spent weeks perfecting the recipe before serving it to his guests. (他花了好幾週反覆改良食譜，才端給客人享用。)

meaning:
vt. 推出；發起；發射
n. 推出；發起；發射
example: The company will launch its first electric delivery van later this year. (該公司將於今年稍晚推出首款電動配送車。)

meaning: n. 出席；在場；存在；鎮定；沉著
example: She had the presence of mind to quickly call for help, which probably saved the young climber's life. (她當下保持冷靜，迅速呼救，很可能因此救了那位年輕登山者一命。)
Financial crime is very hard to detect, because the culprits often hide behind respectable companies and clever paperwork. (金融犯罪很難被查出，因為犯案者往往藏身於聲譽良好的公司和巧妙的文件安排之後。)
The horse carried supplies up the mountain path where vehicles cannot go. (這匹馬沿著車輛無法通行的山徑，把補給品運上山。)
The company advertised the job in several local newspapers, yet very few qualified senior engineers applied. (公司在幾份地方報紙刊登了職缺，但符合資格的資深工程師應徵者寥寥無幾。)

meaning:
n. 進展；進度
v. 進步；前進
example: Progress on the new high-speed railway has been much slower than the government promised. (新建高速鐵路的工程進度遠比政府承諾的慢。)
The pandemic clearly exposed serious weaknesses in the global supply chain, delaying many essential goods for several months. (疫情清楚揭露全球供應鏈的嚴重弱點，讓許多民生必需品延誤數月。)

meaning:
adj. 主要的；首要的
n. 首領；主管
example: The chief reason for the delay was a shortage of skilled workers. (延誤的主要原因是熟練工人短缺。)

meaning:
n. 規模；尺度；刻度
vt. 攀登；按比例調整
example: The full scale of the damage only became clear the next morning. (直到隔天早上，損害的整體規模才明朗。)

meaning:
adj. 雙倍的；雙人的
n. 兩倍；替身
v. 加倍；兼任
example: The council plans to double spending on cycle paths over the next five years. (市議會計畫在未來五年將自行車道支出提高一倍。)
The debate over nuclear power has bitterly divided the country ever since the old coastal plant was closed. (自從那座老舊沿海電廠關閉後，核能辯論便讓全國陷入嚴重分歧。)
Officials warned local residents to stay indoors during the worst of the storm. (官員警告當地居民，在暴風雨最猛烈時要待在室內。)
Scientists are still debating the extent to which rising sea temperatures seriously threaten shallow tropical coral reefs worldwide. (科學家仍在辯論海水升溫在多大程度上嚴重威脅全球的淺海熱帶珊瑚礁。)
The library extends its opening hours during the examination period each year. (圖書館每年都會在考試期間延長開放時間。)
The work is hard manual labour, and few young people are willing to do it. (這是辛苦的體力勞動，很少年輕人願意做。)

meaning:
vi. 回應；作出反應
vt. 以……回應；答覆
example: Plants respond to long dry spells by closing tiny leaf pores, an adaptation that helps them conserve water. (長期乾旱時，植物會關閉葉片上的微小氣孔來應對，這種適應方式有助於保存水分。)
The knife has a very sharp edge, so please handle it carefully. (這把刀的刀刃非常鋒利，請小心拿取。)
She started the small design business with a partner she had met at university. (她和一位在大學認識的合夥人一起創立了這家小型設計公司。)

meaning:
n. 實驗；試驗
v. 進行實驗；嘗試
example: The experiment clearly showed that the plant grew faster under blue light. (這項實驗清楚顯示，這種植物在藍光下生長得比較快。)

meaning:
n. 疼痛；痛苦
v. 使疼痛；使苦惱
example: The pain in his back became so severe that he could not stand upright. (他的背痛變得如此劇烈，以致無法挺直站立。)

meaning:
vt. 看見；認出
n. 地點；斑點；少量
example: From the hill we spotted a herd of deer near the river. (我們從山丘上看見河邊有一群鹿。)
The concept of gravity is easy to name but surprisingly hard to explain to a class of curious children. (重力的概念不難說出來，但要向一群好奇的孩子解釋卻意外地困難。)

meaning:
adj. 最初的；初步的
n. 姓名首字母
example: The initial plan was to build a footbridge, not a road bridge. (最初的計畫是建造人行橋，而不是公路橋。)
The secretary took detailed notes during the meeting and sent them to everyone. (秘書在會議中做了詳細筆記，並寄給每一位與會者。)

meaning:
v. 搖動；震動；握手
n. 搖動；震動；奶昔
example: You should always shake the medicine bottle well before opening it at home. (在家打開藥瓶前，應該先充分搖勻。)
The photograph on the front page captured the moment the rescue team arrived. (頭版上的照片捕捉到救援隊抵達的那一刻。)

meaning:
n. 計畫；方案；體系
v. 策劃；密謀
example: The scheme to plant trees along the road was delayed by funding cuts. (沿著道路植樹的計畫因經費遭刪減而延後。)
The new technique allows farmers to grow vegetables using far less water. (這項新技術讓農民能以少得多的水種植蔬菜。)

meaning:
adv. 分開地；相隔
adj. 分開的；不同的
example: The two villages are only five kilometres apart along the winding river. (沿著蜿蜒的河流，兩座村莊相距僅五公里。)
From this distance, the two towers look almost exactly the same height. (從這個距離看，兩座塔的高度幾乎一模一樣。)

meaning:
n. 衝突；矛盾；爭執
vi. 衝突；不一致
example: The daily conflict between work and family life often becomes increasingly serious when children first start full-time school. (工作與家庭生活之間的日常衝突，常在孩子剛開始全天上學時變得更加嚴重。)

meaning:
v. 舉起；抬高；解除
n. 電梯；搭便車；提升
example: The lift has been out of order since Monday, so staff use the stairs. (電梯從星期一開始故障，因此員工改走樓梯。)
Her excellent final exam results surprised everyone, since she had missed several weeks of school through illness. (她因病缺課好幾週，期末考卻拿下優異成績，讓所有人都很驚訝。)

meaning:
n. 幫忙；恩惠；支持
v. 偏愛；較支持；有利於
example: Could you do me a favour and collect the parcel from the post office? (可以請你幫我一個忙，去郵局領包裹嗎？)

meaning:
n. 錯誤；失誤
v. 誤認；把……弄錯
example: He admitted his mistake immediately and offered to pay for all the damage. (他立刻承認自己的錯誤，並表示願意賠償全部損失。)

meaning:
adj. 親愛的；珍貴的；昂貴的
int. 哎呀；天啊
example: She wrote a long handwritten letter to her dear old friend who lives in Australia. (她寫了一封長長的手寫信，寄給住在澳洲的摯友。)

meaning: n. 改善；進步；改良之處
example: Parents welcomed the steady improvement in reading scores, though teachers warned that one good year proves surprisingly little. (家長樂見閱讀成績穩定進步，但教師提醒，單一年表現良好其實證明不了多少。)
The final chapter of the report discusses how the findings should be used. (報告的最後一章討論應如何運用研究結果。)

meaning: vi. 出現；浮現；脫穎而出
example: New evidence emerged several months after the original investigation had been closed. (原先的調查結束幾個月後，出現了新證據。)
The experiment demonstrates that children learn faster when they explain ideas to classmates rather than simply memorise facts. (實驗顯示，孩子向同學解釋想法，比單純背誦事實學得更快。)
The artist spent three years completing the mural that now covers the entire wall. (這位藝術家花了三年完成如今覆蓋整面牆的壁畫。)

meaning:
v. 改革；改良；改過
n. 改革；改良
example: The government promised to reform the tax system and simplify the complicated rules. (政府承諾改革稅制，並簡化繁複的規定。)
They finally adopted a young child from abroad, a long process that took almost three years. (他們終於從國外收養了一名年幼孩子，整個過程花了將近三年。)

meaning:
v. 減少；降低
n. 減少；降幅
example: Smoking rates decreased steadily after the indoor ban, especially among younger adults in cities. (室內禁菸令實施後，吸菸率穩定下降，城市中的年輕成人尤其明顯。)

meaning:
v. 奮鬥；掙扎；吃力地做
n. 奮鬥；掙扎；鬥爭
example: Many low-income families struggle to pay their rent and heating bills in winter. (許多低收入家庭在冬天得辛苦設法支付房租和暖氣費。)

meaning:
v. 餵養；供給；進食
n. 飼料；資料流；供稿
example: Farmers feed their cattle on locally grown grass rather than imported grain. (農民用當地種植的牧草餵牛，而不使用進口穀物。)

meaning:
n. 營地；露營；陣營
v. 露營；紮營
example: The camp provides basic accommodation for volunteers working on the conservation project. (這座營地為參與保育計畫的志工提供基本住宿。)
Tall reeds surround the whole pond, hiding it completely from the road. (高高的蘆葦環繞整座池塘，讓池塘從道路上完全看不見。)
The entrance fee includes a guided tour of the castle and gardens. (門票包含城堡與花園的導覽行程。)
The crowd cheered loudly as the cyclists crossed the finishing line together. (自行車選手一同越過終點線時，人群大聲歡呼。)

meaning:
adj. 資深的；較高階的；年長的
n. 高年級學生；年長者；資深人士
example: Senior managers were asked to explain the sudden decision to their teams. (資深主管受命向各自的團隊說明這項突然的決定。)
They arranged the flowers themselves, using old jars and branches collected from the garden that morning. (他們用舊罐子和當天早上從花園收集的樹枝，親自插好了花。)
The expense of moving abroad often deters many talented students, even when prestigious universities still offer generous scholarships. (移居海外的費用常使許多優秀學生打消念頭，即使名校仍提供優厚獎學金也是如此。)

meaning:
v. 烹煮；做飯
n. 廚師；炊事人員
example: My father taught me to cook simple meals when I was ten. (我十歲時，父親教我做簡單的餐點。)
The new system combines daily bus and rail tickets, so passengers need only one convenient payment. (新系統整合公車與鐵路的一日票，乘客只需方便地付款一次。)
Cultural differences can cause small misunderstandings at work, so training sessions help new staff settle into the team quickly. (文化差異可能在職場造成小誤會，因此培訓能幫助新進員工迅速融入團隊。)
The museum displays an ancient weapon made from sharp bone and stone. (博物館展示一件以尖銳骨頭和石頭製成的古代武器。)

meaning:
v. 轉移；改變；移動
n. 轉變；輪班；班次
example: The debate suddenly shifted attention to urgent housing, which had been shamefully ignored by both major parties for years. (辯論突然將注意力轉向迫切的住宅問題，而兩大政黨多年來都可恥地忽視了這個議題。)

meaning:
n. 現金；現款
vt. 兌現；領取現金
example: Many small stalls still accept only cash, so bring some with you. (許多小攤販仍然只收現金，所以記得帶一些在身上。)

meaning: adj. 全部的；整個的；完整的
example: The entire interview was published online without editing, which surprised the politician who had expected a short summary. (整場訪談未經編輯便刊登在網路上，讓原本以為只會刊出簡短摘要的政治人物大感意外。)
The failure taught the company a costly lesson about testing products properly. (這次失敗讓公司得到昂貴的教訓：產品必須妥善測試。)
It took him a week to solve the wooden puzzle, and he politely refused all offers of help. (他花了一週才解開那個木製謎題，並禮貌地婉拒所有幫忙的提議。)
The kitchen is narrow, but it has a large window and plenty of light. (廚房很狹窄，但有一扇大窗戶，光線十分充足。)

meaning: n. 失敗；故障；未能做到
example: The failure of the project was blamed on poor planning and weak leadership. (這項計畫的失敗被歸因於規劃不周和領導不力。)
Under normal circumstances the ferry runs hourly, but strong winds cancelled every crossing that afternoon. (一般情況下，渡輪每小時一班；但那天下午因強風，所有航次都取消了。)
The bank will confirm the transfer by email, usually within one working day of submission. (銀行通常會在申請提交後一個工作天內，以電子郵件確認轉帳。)
She covered her mouth with her hand when she heard the surprising news. (聽到這則令人驚訝的消息時，她用手摀住嘴。)
Everyone in the village contributed wood and labour to rebuild the school. (村裡每個人都捐出木材並出力，一起重建學校。)
Translation tools are useful, but they cannot replace a skilled human translator. (翻譯工具很實用，但無法取代熟練的人類譯者。)

meaning:
n. 目標；目的
adj. 客觀的；不偏不倚的
example: Our main objective is to finish the bridge before winter, even if the final painting has to wait. (我們的主要目標是在冬天前完工這座橋，即使最後的油漆工程必須延後。)
The laboratory stores dangerous gases in sealed containers well away from any heat. (實驗室將危險氣體存放在密封容器中，並遠離任何熱源。)
The central library is currently closed while its roof is being repaired. (中央圖書館目前正在整修屋頂，因此暫停開放。)
The council cleans the beach every morning during the busy summer season. (夏季旅遊旺季期間，地方政府每天早上都會清理海灘。)

meaning:
adj. 商業的；營利的；商用的
n. 商業廣告
example: The film was praised by critics but failed as a commercial project, earning far less than its budget. (這部電影受到影評人好評，但商業上並不成功，收入遠低於製作預算。)

meaning: n. 流行音樂；流行文化
example: Pop music is often criticised for being simple, yet it reaches enormous audiences. (流行音樂常因內容簡單而受到批評，卻能觸及極為廣大的聽眾。)

meaning:
n. 變數；變因
adj. 可變的；易變的
example: Rainfall is a key variable when predicting how well crops will grow. (預測作物生長情況時，降雨量是關鍵變數。)

meaning: n. 大腦；腦力；聰明的人
example: Regular exercise and enough sleep help the brain work more efficiently during the day. (規律運動和充足睡眠能幫助大腦在白天更有效率地運作。)
Early screening greatly improves the chances of treating several common forms of cancer successfully. (及早篩檢能大幅提高幾種常見癌症成功治療的機會。)

meaning: vi. 繼續進行；接著做；前往
example: Work on the new library will proceed once the old pipes have been safely removed from the site. (舊管線安全移出工地後，新圖書館工程就會繼續進行。)
The city faces a water crisis, and its reservoirs may run dry within months. (這座城市面臨水資源危機，水庫可能在幾個月內乾涸。)

meaning:
v. 隱藏；遮掩；躲藏
n. 獸皮；皮革
example: The old wallpaper hides cracks that would cost a lot to repair properly. (老舊壁紙遮住了一些裂縫，要妥善修補它們得花不少錢。)
The shop refused to refund the money because the receipt had been lost. (店家因收據遺失而拒絕退款。)
One consequence of his career decision was a sudden move abroad, which clearly surprised all his former colleagues. (他做出職涯決定後，突然搬到國外生活，這個結果顯然讓所有前同事都很驚訝。)
The volume of traffic through the village has doubled, making the narrow main street increasingly dangerous for cyclists. (穿越村莊的車流量已增加一倍，讓狹窄的主要街道對騎自行車的人愈來愈危險。)

meaning:
n. 趨勢；走向
vi. 呈現趨勢；傾向
example: The trend towards smaller households has sharply increased demand for city flats. (家庭戶數與規模縮小的趨勢，大幅推升城市公寓的需求。)
Traffic into the city centre is restricted during the morning rush hour each weekday. (每個平日的早晨尖峰時段，進入市中心的交通都會受到限制。)

meaning:
n. 大量；一大群；團塊
adj. 大規模的；大眾的
v. 聚集；集中
example: A mass of tourists gathered outside the art gallery before it opened. (美術館開館前，一大群遊客聚集在外面。)
The length of the waiting list has doubled since the clinic closed. (診所關閉以來，候診名單的長度已經增加一倍。)

meaning: v. 不同；變化；使多樣化
example: Ticket prices vary depending on the day of the week and the season. (票價會依星期幾和季節而有所不同。)
Ticket revenue alone cannot fund the local stadium, so the club also sells advertising space and annual memberships. (單靠門票收入無法支應地方體育場的營運，因此球團也販售廣告版位和年度會員資格。)
It is the legal duty of all employers to provide a safe working environment. (提供安全的工作環境，是所有雇主的法定義務。)

meaning:
v. 重複；再說一次；重演
adj. 再次的；重複的
example: The teacher repeated the question slowly so that everyone could write down the answer. (老師慢慢重複問題，讓每個人都有時間寫下答案。)
The mountain attracts thousands of walkers each year, putting pressure on narrow paths. (這座山每年吸引數千名健行者，對狹窄步道造成負擔。)
Unfortunately, the library roof leaked badly during the storm, damaging dozens of rare local history books. (很不幸，暴風雨期間圖書館屋頂嚴重漏水，造成數十本珍貴的地方史書籍受損。)
Many small local bookshops still survive only because loyal customers regularly order books instead of buying cheaper online. (許多地方小書店之所以仍能生存，只因忠實顧客定期向店家訂書，而不選擇上網買較便宜的書。)

meaning:
n. 時刻表；行程表；計畫
v. 安排；排定
example: The train schedule changes in December, so busy commuters should carefully check times before travelling during the holidays. (火車時刻表在十二月會調整，因此通勤繁忙的人假期出行前應仔細確認時間。)
Researchers employ simple short surveys to measure happiness, although critics question whether such numbers really mean much at all. (研究人員用簡短的問卷衡量幸福感，但批評者質疑這些數字究竟有多大意義。)

meaning:
adj. 必要的；不可或缺的；基本的
n. 必需品；要素
example: Good lighting is essential for anyone who works at a computer all day. (對整天使用電腦工作的人來說，良好的照明不可或缺。)

meaning: adj. 關鍵的；至關重要的；批判性的
example: Early diagnosis is absolutely critical, since treatment works far better before the disease spreads to other organs. (早期診斷至關重要，因為在疾病擴散到其他器官前治療，效果會好得多。)

meaning:
n. 風扇；扇子；愛好者
v. 煽動；扇風
example: A large fan in the corner kept the small office cool during summer. (角落裡的大風扇讓小辦公室在夏天保持涼爽。)

meaning: n. 航班；飛行；樓梯的一段
example: Our flight to Hong Kong was delayed for two hours because of heavy fog. (濃霧使我們飛往香港的航班延誤了兩小時。)

meaning:
adj. 相等的；平等的；勝任的
vt. 等於；比得上
example: The law requires that men and women receive equal pay for work of the same value. (法律要求男女從事同等價值的工作時，應領取同等薪酬。)

meaning:
prep. 加上；外加
n. 加號；優點；額外好處
example: The rent is reasonable, plus the flat is close to the metro station. (租金合理，而且公寓離地鐵站很近。)

meaning:
n. 教練；長途巴士；客車車廂
vt. 訓練；指導
example: The coach was unfortunately delayed by roadworks, so we missed the next ferry and waited two long hours. (長途巴士不巧因道路施工延誤，害我們錯過下一班渡輪，足足等了兩個小時。)
It was a pleasure to meet the author and discuss her latest novel. (能與作者見面並討論她最新的小說，真令人愉快。)
The campaign promotes daily walking to school, hoping both to reduce local traffic and improve children's overall fitness. (這項活動提倡每天步行上學，希望減少當地車流並提升孩子的整體體能。)
Students from a poorer background often work longer hours, which leaves them less time for study and rest. (家境較差的學生往往得工作更長時間，因此留給讀書和休息的時間更少。)
The local union warned that staff shortages could permanently close the clinic unless more nurses were quickly hired. (當地工會警告，若不儘快增聘護理師，人手不足可能導致診所永久關閉。)
The provision of affordable childcare allows more parents to return to work, especially in areas with long waiting lists. (提供價格合理的托育服務，能讓更多父母重返職場，尤其是在候補名單很長的地區。)
Staff genuinely appreciate flexible working hours, yet some managers worry that office teamwork suffers when people rarely meet. (員工真心感激彈性工時，但有些主管擔心同事很少碰面會損害團隊合作。)

meaning:
n. 法規；規範；代碼
vt. 編碼；編寫程式
example: New buildings must follow a strict energy code that limits heat loss in winter. (新建築必須遵守嚴格的能源規範，以限制冬季熱能散失。)

meaning: vt. 使能夠；使可能；啟用
example: A simple text reminder can enable patients to remember to take their medication even when their busy daily routine changes. (即使忙碌的日常作息有變化，簡單的簡訊提醒也能幫助病人記得服藥。)

meaning:
n. 包裹；一套方案；套裝
v. 包裝；整理成套
example: A small package arrived for you this morning, but nobody signed for it. (今天早上有一個小包裹寄到給你，但沒有人簽收。)

meaning:
vt. 製造；大量生產；捏造
n. 製造；製造業
example: The company manufactures bicycle parts and exports them to more than twenty countries. (這家公司製造自行車零件，並出口到二十多個國家。)
Shareholders voted against the plan because it would reduce profits for several years. (股東投票反對這項計畫，因為它會讓利潤連續幾年減少。)

Medical students spend hours reading the latest literature on treatments for rare diseases. (醫學生花好幾個小時閱讀治療罕見疾病的最新文獻。)

meaning: adv. 主要地；大多；基本上

meaning:
vi. 盯著看；凝視

meaning:

meaning: n. 客人；賓客；特邀來賓

Her commitment to the youth club kept it running for a decade. (她對青少年俱樂部的投入，讓這個社團持續運作了十年。)
The stadium's capacity was reduced during major repairs, so thousands of fans simply watched the match at home. (體育場大規模整修期間，容納人數減少，因此數千名球迷只好在家看比賽。)
Sunlight can damage the skin, so wear protection even on cloudy days. (陽光可能傷害皮膚，因此即使陰天也要做好防護。)
Living abroad for a year gave her a different perspective on her own culture. (在國外生活一年，讓她用不同的觀點看待自己的文化。)
These old documents belong in the archive, not in the manager's office. (這些舊文件應該放在檔案室，而不是經理辦公室。)
Each participant was interviewed twice, and those who missed a session were later asked to explain their absence. (每位參加者都接受兩次訪談，缺席一場的人之後會被要求說明原因。)

meaning: n. 比較；對照；比較結果

A strong belief in local produce drew customers to her small shop. (她堅信本地農產品的價值，吸引顧客走進她的小店。)

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: n. 時尚；流行方式；做法

meaning: adj. 技術的；專門的；工藝的

meaning: v. 否認；拒絕給予；不准

meaning: adj. 友善的；親切的；適用的

meaning:
n. 場合；時機；特殊事件
vt. 引起；造成

meaning: n. 領導；領導能力；領導階層

meaning:

meaning:

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: adj. 適合的；合適的；相稱的
example: This soil is not suitable for growing rice because it drains too quickly. (這種土壤排水太快，不適合種植稻米。)

meaning: adj. 內部的；體內的；內心的
example: An internal review found that the delays were caused by poor planning. (內部檢討發現，延誤是由於規劃不周所造成。)

meaning: n. 事件；事務；風流韻事

meaning:

meaning:
v. 懷疑；猜想
n. 嫌疑犯；可疑人物

The dictionary's definition of the term is clearer than the one in my textbook. (字典對這個詞的定義比課本上的版本更清楚。)

meaning:
v. 逮捕；阻止；吸引
n. 逮捕；停止

Inspectors will investigate why the water in the lake suddenly turned green. (檢查人員將調查湖水突然變成綠色的原因。)

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常見的；親近的

meaning:

meaning:
n. 索引；指數；指標
v. 編索引；為……建立索引

A strong recommendation from her previous supervisor helped her secure the full-time job, even though she lacked formal experience. (前任主管的大力推薦，幫助她取得這份全職工作，儘管她缺乏正式經驗。)
Several guests complained that the air conditioning was too noisy, so the manager offered them a free night. (幾位房客抱怨空調太吵，因此經理提供他們一晚免費住宿。)

meaning:
n. 民意調查；投票；票數
v. 進行民調；獲得票數

meaning:
n. 逃脫；逃避；出口
v. 逃脫；逃避；漏出

meaning:
n. 開關；轉變；交換
v. 切換；轉換；交換

meaning: adj. 可愛的；美好的；令人愉快的

meaning:
n. 許可證；執照

meaning:

Economists failed to predict the sudden sharp global rise in food prices, which really hit local households hardest. (經濟學家未能預測全球糧價突然大幅上漲，而當地家庭受到的衝擊尤其嚴重。)

A small device worn on the wrist can warn diabetes patients before their blood sugar falls dangerously low. (戴在手腕上的小型裝置，能在糖尿病患者的血糖降至危險低點前發出警告。)
Researchers analyse the water samples in order to identify traces of heavy metals. (研究人員分析水樣本，以找出重金屬的痕跡。)

meaning: adv. 必然地；一定；不可避免地

meaning: n. 受害者；犧牲者；受騙者

meaning:
n. 委託；佣金；委員會

example: The artist accepted a commission to paint a portrait of the mayor. (這位藝術家接受委託，為市長繪製肖像畫。)

meaning: n. 結合；組合；密碼鎖號碼

meaning:
adj. 保守的；守舊的；節制的

meaning:

meaning:
n. 等級；排名；階級

meaning:
n. 虐待；濫用；辱罵

meaning:
n. 產量；收益；屈服

meaning:
n. 根；根源；詞根
v. 生根；使扎根；翻找
example: The tree's roots spread widely and damage the pavement outside the house. (這棵樹的根向四周蔓延，損壞了屋外的人行道。)

meaning:

v. 確保；取得；固定

meaning: v. 選舉；推選；決定採取
example: The members will elect a new chair at the annual general meeting in June. (成員將在六月的年度大會上選出新主席。)

meaning:
n. 鏈條；連鎖店；一連串

example: The supermarket chain plans to open ten new stores in smaller towns. (這家連鎖超市計畫在小型城鎮開設十家新店。)
Speaking in front of the class slowly built her confidence in English. (在全班面前發言，逐漸建立起她使用英文的信心。)

meaning:
n. 框架；窗框；骨架

meaning: n. 身分；身分認同；特徵

meaning: v. 負擔得起；提供；抽得出時間

meaning:
n. 品牌；商標；類型

meaning:
v. 評分；分級；評定
n. 年級；等級；成績

Rising sea levels threaten low-lying islands and many coastal communities around the world. (海平面上升威脅低窪島嶼和世界各地許多沿海社區。)

meaning:
v. 租用；聘用；僱用
n. 租用；租金
example: We hired a car for three days to explore the coast at our own pace. (我們租了三天車，好按照自己的步調探索海岸。)

meaning:

meaning: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；通常的

High concentrations of salt in the soil prevent most crops from growing well. (土壤中的鹽分濃度過高，會妨礙大多數作物生長。)

meaning:
n. 居民；住戶；常駐人員

meaning: n. 一段時間；課程；會期

meaning:
n. 碩士；主人；大師
v. 精通；掌握；控制
example: She completed a master's degree while working full time at the bank. (她在銀行全職工作的同時，完成了碩士學位。)

meaning: adj. 狹窄的；有限的；狹隘的
example: The narrow street was never designed for the number of cars using it today. (這條狹窄街道當初並未依照今日的車流量設計。)

meaning:
n. 畢業生；研究生
v. 畢業；取得學位；逐步發展
