meaning:
vt. 實施；執行；落實
n. 工具；器具
example: The primary school will implement the new reading programme from September onwards. (這所小學將從九月起實施新的閱讀計畫。)
Approximately two hundred people attended the public meeting, though the hall was designed for only half that number. (約有兩百人出席這場公開會議，但會堂原本只按一半的人數設計。)

meaning: v. 取得資格；合格；限定
example: Nurses must qualify before they are allowed to work in public hospitals. (護理師必須先取得資格，才能在公立醫院工作。)
The regional hospital will close its maternity unit next year, forcing expectant mothers to travel to the city. (這家區域醫院明年將關閉產科病房，迫使準媽媽們前往市區就醫。)
The plan was based on the assumption that the river would stay low. (這項計畫是以河水水位會持續偏低這個假設為基礎。)
The closure of the main road will be temporary while workers repair the drain. (工人修理排水溝期間，這條主要道路只會暫時封閉。)

meaning: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
example: The job offered an attractive salary, yet the constant travel made it unsuitable for anyone with young children. (這份工作提供優渥誘人的薪水，但頻繁出差使它不適合有年幼子女的人。)
The Pacific plate moves slowly beneath the ocean floor, causing frequent earthquakes. (太平洋板塊在海床下方緩慢移動，因而經常引發地震。)
The frequency of local buses to the village has now fallen sharply, leaving many elderly residents increasingly isolated. (如今前往村莊的公車班次大幅減少，許多年長居民因此愈發孤立。)

meaning:
v. 滑倒；滑動；悄悄移動
n. 滑倒；失誤；紙條
example: He slipped on the narrow icy path, but a kind passer-by caught his arm before he could fall. (他在狹窄結冰的小路上滑了一下，但一位好心路人在他跌倒前扶住了他的手臂。)
The surprise election victory gave the party a clear majority in the national parliament. (這場出乎意料的選舉勝利，讓該黨在國會取得明確的多數席次。)

meaning:
n. 圓；圓圈；圈子
v. 圈出；環繞；盤旋
example: A circle of white stones still marks the ancient meeting place high on the hill. (一圈白石至今仍標示著山丘高處的古代集會地點。)

meaning:
adj. 學術的；學業的；理論的
n. 學者；大學教師
example: Academic research on sleep has changed the way schools plan their timetables. (有關睡眠的學術研究改變了學校安排課表的方式。)

meaning:
n. 笑話；玩笑
v. 開玩笑；說笑
example: He told a joke about a lost umbrella, and the whole class laughed. (他講了一個關於雨傘遺失的笑話，全班都笑了。)
This county borders three others, which so often makes regional transport planning genuinely complicated and highly politically sensitive. (這個郡與另外三個郡接壤，因此區域交通規劃往往相當複雜，也高度牽涉政治敏感議題。)
A wide hat protects the face and neck from strong summer sunshine. (寬帽能保護臉部和頸部，免受夏日強烈陽光照射。)

meaning: v. 偷竊；竊取；偷偷取得
example: It is surprisingly easy to steal a bicycle left outside the library. (偷走放在圖書館外的自行車，竟然出乎意料地容易。)
She bought a dozen eggs and two loaves of bread at the market. (她在市場買了一打雞蛋和兩條麵包。)

meaning:
v. 踢；踹；踢球
n. 踢；踢球；刺激感
example: She kicked the ball into the net in the final minute of the game. (她在比賽最後一分鐘把球踢進球網。)
Cheap student accommodation near the campus is scarce, so many undergraduates share crowded flats far from the library. (校園附近便宜的學生住宿很少，因此許多大學生合住在離圖書館很遠的擁擠公寓裡。)
A dry cough was the first symptom she noticed before the fever began. (發燒開始前，她最先注意到的症狀是乾咳。)

meaning:
n. 家庭；一家人
adj. 家庭的；家用的
example: The average household in this city uses less water than a decade ago. (這座城市的平均家庭用水量比十年前少。)
Tennis courts in the park are free, but visitors must book them in advance. (公園裡的網球場免費，但訪客必須提前預約。)
Faster phones are merely one part of the solution, since reliable networks matter far more in remote mountain areas. (更快速的手機只是解決方案的一部分，因為在偏遠山區，可靠的網路重要得多。)
Her voice showed little emotion as she read the letter, though everyone knew how much the news meant. (她讀信時聲音中幾乎沒有流露情緒，儘管大家都知道這個消息對她有多重要。)
Engineers calculated that the bridge could safely carry twice its current volume of traffic. (工程師計算出這座橋能安全承載目前兩倍的交通量。)
The local newspaper accused the company of deliberately hiding evidence about the fatal river accident. (當地報紙指控該公司蓄意隱瞞那起致命河川事故的證據。)

meaning:
adj. 犯罪的；刑事的
n. 罪犯；犯人
example: The police opened a criminal investigation into the misuse of public funds. (警方針對公款遭濫用一事展開刑事調查。)
He inherited a large estate in the countryside, including several farms and a forest. (他繼承了鄉間一大片莊園土地，其中包括幾座農場和一片森林。)
Her original interpretation of the painting differs from the guidebook, but the curator still finds it surprisingly convincing. (她對這幅畫的獨到詮釋與導覽手冊不同，但館長仍覺得這種解讀出乎意料地有說服力。)

meaning: n. 標準；準則；衡量條件
example: Applicants must meet several strict criteria, including relevant experience and two good references. (申請者必須符合幾項嚴格標準，包括具備相關經驗和兩封良好的推薦信。)
The board appointed her as chief executive after a long global search. (董事會經過長時間的全球遴選後，任命她為執行長。)
The two countries remained enemy states for decades before signing a peace treaty. (簽署和平條約之前，這兩個國家數十年來一直是敵對國。)

meaning:
adj. 助理的；副手的
n. 助理；助手
example: The research assistant checked every figure twice, yet a small error still slipped into the published final table. (研究助理把每個數字都核對了兩次，但一個小錯誤仍混進已發表的最終表格。)

meaning: adj. 甜的；芳香的；親切的
example: The local oranges are so sweet that they need no added sugar. (當地柳橙非常甜，不必另外加糖。)

meaning: adj. 持續一致的；穩定的；前後連貫的
example: Her training times have been consistent since she changed coaches last spring. (自從去年春天更換教練後，她的訓練成績一直很穩定。)
Doctors advise older patients to exercise gently and to avoid long periods of sitting. (醫師建議年長病患適度運動，並避免長時間坐著。)

meaning: adj. 慷慨的；自由派的；寬鬆的
example: He is liberal with his time and often helps neighbours repair their bicycles. (他很樂意付出時間，常幫鄰居修理腳踏車。)

meaning: adv. 同時；與此同時；在此期間
example: The library closed for repairs; meanwhile, staff worked from a temporary office. (圖書館因維修而關閉；在此期間，員工改在臨時辦公室工作。)
My first impression of the interviewer was quite positive, although her later questions proved unusually direct and detailed. (我對面試官的第一印象相當正面，儘管她後來提出的問題出奇地直接而詳盡。)
The existence of this rare species was finally confirmed only last year, when a camera captured it alive. (直到去年攝影機拍到這個稀有物種的活體，牠的存在才終於獲得確認。)
The exhibition of local pottery runs until the end of the month. (當地陶器展覽會持續展出到月底。)
Children under ten must be accompanied by an adult in the pool area. (十歲以下的兒童在泳池區必須由成人陪同。)

meaning:
n. 產量；輸出；產出
vt. 輸出；產出
example: The solar farm's annual output rose sharply, because the summer was unusually sunny and the panels had just been cleaned. (由於夏季異常晴朗，而且太陽能板剛清潔完，這座太陽能電場的年發電量大幅增加。)
Her salary increased sharply after she completed the demanding two-year professional training course. (完成要求嚴格、為期兩年的專業訓練課程後，她的薪水大幅增加。)
Please attach a photograph to the form and sign at the bottom. (請在表格上附上一張照片，並在底部簽名。)

meaning: v. 承認；確認收到；致意
example: He acknowledged that the long delay was entirely his fault and apologised. (他承認這次長時間延誤完全是自己的錯，並且道歉了。)

meaning: adj. 首要的；主要的；最佳的
example: This old bridge is a prime example of Victorian engineering, although it now needs some urgent expensive repairs. (這座老橋是維多利亞時代工程的典型代表，不過現在需要緊急且昂貴的維修。)

meaning:
n. 獎賞；報酬；懸賞金
vt. 獎勵；酬謝
example: A reward of five thousand dollars was offered for the missing dog. (有人懸賞五千美元尋找那隻走失的狗。)

meaning:
v. 打擾；使煩惱；費心
n. 麻煩；煩擾
example: Please do not bother the driver while the bus is moving, since even a short distraction can be dangerous. (公車行駛時請不要打擾司機，因為即使短暫分心也可能很危險。)

meaning:
adj. 灰色的；陰沉的；灰白頭髮的
n. 灰色；灰白色
example: The sky turned grey before the storm, and the wind grew stronger. (暴風雨來臨前，天空轉為灰色，風勢也變強了。)

meaning: vt. 揭露；使暴露於；使接觸
example: The documentary exposed serious local corruption, yet the senior officials involved still flatly deny any kind of wrongdoing. (這部紀錄片揭露了當地嚴重的貪腐，但涉案高階官員仍斷然否認有任何不當行為。)
Her intention was to work abroad for two years, then return home. (她打算先到國外工作兩年，之後再回家。)

meaning:
vt. 訓練；懲戒；管教
n. 紀律；自律；學科
example: Marathon training demands real discipline, especially on cold winter mornings when staying in a warm bed feels far easier. (馬拉松訓練需要真正的自律，尤其在寒冷的冬日早晨，留在溫暖的床上顯得容易得多。)
Take this medicine twice a day after meals and avoid alcohol while using it. (這種藥每天飯後服用兩次，服用期間要避免飲酒。)

meaning:
n. 意見；投入；輸入
vt. 輸入；投入
example: Senior teachers were asked for their input before the school replaced printed textbooks with tablets in every classroom. (學校要在每間教室以平板取代紙本教科書之前，先徵詢資深教師的意見。)

meaning: vi. 不同；有差異；意見不一
example: Local opinions differ completely about whether the old market should be demolished. (對於是否應該拆除舊市場，當地居民的意見截然不同。)
Farm workers demanded a higher minimum wage because living costs had risen sharply. (由於生活成本大幅上漲，農場工人要求提高最低工資。)

meaning: n. 含意；暗示；可能造成的影響
example: The report's implication is that spending on public transport must rise sharply. (這份報告暗示，大眾運輸支出必須大幅增加。)

meaning: adj. 大量的；重大的；相當可觀的
example: The study found a substantial drop in child asthma after the bus depot moved outside the city centre. (研究發現，公車調度站遷出市中心後，兒童氣喘病例大幅下降。)

meaning: adj. 永久的；長期的；固定的
example: The dam caused permanent damage to the entire valley, and several small local villages were never completely rebuilt. (水壩對整座山谷造成永久性的破壞，當地幾個小村莊也始終未能完全重建。)

meaning:
n. 嬰兒；幼兒
adj. 嬰兒的；初期的
example: An infant should be breastfed or given formula milk for the first months. (嬰兒最初幾個月應以母乳或配方奶餵養。)

meaning:
v. 說；評論；注意到
n. 話語；評論；引人注目的事物
example: A guest quietly remarked that the soup needed more salt, which embarrassed the young cook. (一位客人輕聲表示湯還需要多加些鹽，讓年輕廚師感到尷尬。)
The injury to his shoulder kept him out of the team for six weeks. (肩膀受傷使他六週無法參加球隊活動。)
Someone knocked loudly on the door twice, but nobody answered from inside. (有人大聲敲了兩下門，但裡面沒有人回應。)
The local currency lost value quickly, so prices changed almost every week. (當地貨幣迅速貶值，因此物價幾乎每週都在變動。)
The manufacturer recalled the lamps after several customers reported smoke from them. (幾位顧客通報燈具冒煙後，製造商便召回了這批燈。)
